title: Electronic Structure Calculations from Occupation Numbers on Quantum Computers
summary: We present a quantum-classical algorithm for electronic structure calculations that dramatically reduces the quantum measurement cost of variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) approaches. While conventional VQE methods require measurements scaling as O(M^4) with system size M, the proposed occupation-number VQE (ON-VQE) reduces this cost to O(M/2) by avoiding reduced density matrix (RDM) measurements and relying exclusively on ONs. The method exploits only the diagonal elements of the one-particle RDM in the natural orbital representation, where occupations are obtained directly from computational-basis measurement outcomes. By restricting the variational ansatz to double excitations within orbital subspaces associated with electron pairs, the required measurements can be grouped into a small number of qubit-wise commuting observables, yielding an efficient and scalable measurement strategy. The approach is validated through simulations and executions on quantum hardware for the cubic H$_8$ cluster, demonstrating the feasibility of extracting accurate ONs from quantum measurements and evaluating electronic energies within the natural orbital functional (NOF) framework. Across representative molecular systems, the extracted ONs enable accurate energy evaluation with state-of-the-art NOFs while maintaining a dramatically reduced measurement cost. These results establish a scalable route toward quantum simulation of strongly correlated electronic systems, demonstrating that accurate electronic energies can be obtained from quantum measurements of ONs alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ON-VQE算法，通过仅测量自然轨道占据数（ONs）将量子测量成本从O(M⁴)降至O(M/2)，并在量子硬件上对H₈团簇进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 传统VQE方法需要测量约O(M⁴)个算符（涉及约化密度矩阵），测量成本随系统规模急剧增长，严重限制了量子模拟可处理的分子系统大小。
AI.method: 1) 避免测量完整的约化密度矩阵（RDM），仅利用自然轨道表象中单粒子RDM的对角元（即占据数ONs）；2) 将变分拟设限制在电子对轨道子空间内的双激发，使可观测量可分组为少量qubit-wise对易的可观测量。
AI.result: 在立方H₈团簇的模拟和真实量子硬件上验证了该方法，证明可从量子测量中准确提取ONs，并结合自然轨道泛函（NOF）评估电子能量，在多个分子系统中均保持极低的测量成本。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一条可扩展的强关联电子系统量子模拟路径，证明仅从量子测量的占据数即可获得准确的电子能量，大幅降低了VQE的测量开销。

title: A Mesoscopic Ginzburg--Landau Model for Vibrational Strong Coupling Enhanced Rayleigh Scattering in Molecular Liquids
summary: Recent experiments by Sandeep \textit{et al.} [Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 65, e16917 (2026)] suggest that vibrational strong coupling (VSC) in molecular liquids can generate mesoscopic phenomena beyond single-molecule observables, including resonantly enhanced Rayleigh scattering, abrupt concentration thresholds, and thermal collapse. Motivated by these observations, we construct a mesoscopic Ginzburg--Landau model with two coupled fields: a cavity-controlled collective vibrational polarization $P$ and a secondary structural field $m$ whose long-wavelength susceptibility is renormalized by the collective vibrational polarization intensity $P^2$, assumed to govern long-wavelength density/dielectric fluctuations. With calibrated parameters, the model captures the observed Rayleigh enhancement, collective scaling relations, and threshold-like behavior, while explaining why polaritonic/IR signatures may persist when Rayleigh scattering disappears. The model further predicts enhanced long-wavelength density/dielectric correlations, enlarged mesoscopic correlation lengths, and slowed structural dynamics in the regime with strong Rayleigh enhancement, providing direct experimental tests through small-angle X-ray/neutron scattering and dynamic light-scattering probes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个介观Ginzburg-Landau模型，通过耦合振动极化场和结构场来解释振动强耦合下液体中观察到的瑞利散射增强、浓度阈值和热崩塌等介观现象，并预测了可实验检验的长程密度/介电关联和慢化结构动力学。
AI.motivation: Sandeep等人的近期实验表明，分子液体中的振动强耦合（VSC）能产生超越单分子可观测量的介观现象，包括共振增强瑞利散射、突然的浓度阈值和热崩塌。作者旨在构建一个理论模型来理解这些现象。
AI.method: 构建介观Ginzburg-Landau模型，包含两个耦合场：腔控集体振动极化P和次级结构场m，其中m的长波磁化率通过集体振动极化强度P²重整化，并假设P²控制长波密度/介电涨落。通过校准参数进行数值模拟。
AI.result: 模型成功捕捉到观测到的瑞利增强、集体标度关系和阈值行为，并能解释为何在瑞利散射消失时极化子/红外特征仍存在。模型还预测了强瑞利增强区域中长程密度/介电关联增强、介观关联长度增大以及结构动力学减慢。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为VSC下的介观现象提供了统一的理论框架，并通过预测可被小角X射线/中子散射和动态光散射实验检验的效应，为未来实验验证指明了方向。

title: $GW$ reduced density matrix from iterated linearized Dyson equation
summary: Iterating the Dyson equation with the static part of the self-energy leads to a concise and possibly improved expression of the one-body reduced density matrix from any self-energy approximation. Here we apply the procedure to Hedin's $GW$ approximation. The non-iterated $GW$ based density matrix was already known to yield accurate density matrices for molecular systems. We show that the Dyson-equation-based procedure is equivalent to the so-called variational Z-vector approach applied to the Random-Phase approximation energy functional, but only in the case of a Hartree-Fock mean-field starting point. When a generalized Kohn-Sham scheme is employed instead, the two approaches differ. By comparing the density matrix for a benchmark set of 34 small molecules to coupled-cluster reference values, we conclude that the iterated Dyson equation indeed produces improved density matrices for molecular systems. Interestingly, we observe that the excitation rank of the reference coupled-cluster matters much and that the inclusion of triple excitations (CCSDT) quantitatively changes the conclusions of the benchmark as compared to single and double excitations coupled-cluster (CCSD).

AI.tldr: 本文提出对GW近似自能进行Dyson方程迭代来改进单粒子约化密度矩阵，证明该迭代等价于变分Z-vector方法（仅限HF起点），并通过34个小分子基准测试发现迭代的GW密度矩阵优于非迭代版本，且参考CC方法的激发阶数显著影响结论。
AI.motivation: 从GW近似自能出发得到更精确的单粒子约化密度矩阵，并澄清其与Z-vector方法的关系。
AI.method: 对自能的静态部分迭代Dyson方程得到密度矩阵表达式；将该方法应用于GW近似；在HF和GKS两种起点下与变分Z-vector方法进行理论对比；对34个小分子进行CCSD和CCSDT基准测试。
AI.result: 迭代Dyson方程的GW密度矩阵优于非迭代版本；与Z-vector方法等价仅在HF起点成立，GKS起点下两者不同；CCSDT与CCSD的参考结果存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: Dyson方程迭代是一种有效改进GW密度矩阵的策略，且基准测试中三激发（CCSDT）的纳入会定量改变结论，说明高阶关联不可忽视。

title: Nonadiabatic excited-state dynamics with quantum Monte Carlo-trained machine learning: azomethane as a stringent test
summary: We introduce quantum Monte Carlo (QMC)-trained multi-state machine-learned (ML) force fields for nonadiabatic excited-state dynamics, targeting photochemical processes in which the electronic character changes along the reaction path and a consistent correlated description is required. In this framework, variational Monte Carlo wave functions combine compact selected configuration-interaction expansions with a Jastrow factor that explicitly accounts for dynamical correlation, while neural networks convert the stochastic QMC data into smooth potential energy surfaces for large surface-hopping ensembles. We apply this approach to azomethane, a demanding test case involving torsional relaxation through conical-intersection regions and C--N bond dissociation on the hot ground state. Benchmark calculations support the accuracy of the QMC reference data and show robust force convergence across isomerization and dissociation geometries. The QMC-trained dynamics preserves the expected photoisomerization mechanism, strongly reduces the excessive C--N breaking obtained with complete active space self-consistent field, and predicts a small but non-negligible prompt dissociation component after internal conversion, with a timescale consistent with femtosecond-resolved mass-spectrometry experiments. These results establish QMC-ML as a practical route to nonadiabatic photochemical dynamics with accurate wave-function reference data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合量子蒙特卡洛(QMC)与机器学习(ML)的多态力场方法，用于非绝热激发态动力学模拟，并以偶氮甲烷为例验证了该方法在光化学过程中的准确性和实用性。
AI.motivation: 光化学过程中电子态特征沿反应路径发生变化，需要一致的相关描述，而传统方法(如CASSCF)在描述锥形交叉和键解离时存在不足，亟需一种高精度且计算可行的非绝热动力学方法。
AI.method: 采用变分蒙特卡洛波函数(结合压缩选态组态相互作用展开和Jastrow因子)生成高精度参考数据，再通过神经网络将随机QMC数据转换为光滑势能面，用于大系综面跳跃动力学模拟。
AI.result: 基准测试验证了QMC参考数据的准确性；QMC-ML动力学保留了预期的光异构化机制，显著减少了CASSCF中过度的C-N键断裂，并预测了内转换后存在小而不可忽略的快速解离组分，时间尺度与飞秒质谱实验一致。
AI.conclusion: QMC-ML为非绝观光化学动力学提供了一条基于准确波函数参考数据的实用路径。

title: Field-induced first order transitions and phase coexistence in the Kitaev quantum spin liquid candidate BaCo2(AsO4)2
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures + supporting info, 20 pages and 5 figures
summary: BaCo2(AsO4)2 (BCAO) is an insulating Kitaev quantum spin liquid candidate with a rich low-temperature phase diagram. Below 5 K, it exhibits double-zigzag magnetic order. Upon application of an in-plane magnetic field, the magnetic structure first transforms into an up-up-down (UUD) state near 0.12 T and then enters a fully spin-polarized ferromagnetic (FM) state near 0.5 T. In the narrow field regime close to the polarized phase, a finite residual thermal conductivity has been reported, suggesting a possible field-induced quantum spin liquid phase. Using neutron scattering, we show that the field-induced double-zigzag-to-UUD transition near 0.15 T is accompanied by the emergence of a cluster of localized UUD spin excitations that coexist with conventional spin waves. Upon further increasing field, BCAO undergoes a first-order UUD-to-FM transition with coexistence of UUD and FM phases, accompanied by a sharp response in the spin Seebeck coefficient. These results do not support a quantum spin liquid scenario near the UUD-to-FM critical field. Instead, modeling indicates that the broad excitations arise from bound spin-flip pairs, while a low-lying dispersive branch near the FM phase boundary carries the same sign of magnetization as the FM order. These excitations naturally account for the observed sign of the spin Seebeck response and are likely relevant to the thermal conductivity near the critical field.

AI.tldr: BCAO在磁场诱导下经历双Z字形→UUD→铁磁相变，在UUD-FM临界场附近观察到的宽激发源于束缚自旋翻转对，而非量子自旋液体，这些激发可解释热导率和自旋Seebeck效应。
AI.motivation: 探究BCAO在磁场驱动相变中是否存在场诱导量子自旋液体(QSL)相，特别是UUD-FM临界场附近的残余热导率异常的物理起源。
AI.method: 利用中子散射技术观测磁场下的自旋激发谱，结合理论建模分析激发特性，并通过自旋Seebeck系数测量进行佐证。
AI.result: 发现双Z字形→UUD相变伴随局域化UUD自旋激发与自旋波共存；UUD→FM为一级相变，两相共存；宽激发源于束缚自旋翻转对，非QSL特征。
AI.conclusion: 排除了BCAO在UUD-FM临界场附近存在量子自旋液体的可能性，提出束缚自旋翻转对模型可自然解释自旋Seebeck信号的符号和热导率行为。

title: First-Order Topological FFLO Transition and Superconducting Diode Sign Reversal in Altermagnetic Nanowires
summary: Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) state conventionally emerges via a second-order phase transition driven by finite magnetization. Here we show that a spin-orbit-coupled nanowire proximitized to $d$-wave altermagnets -- with zero net magnetization -- can realize topological FFLO states through a first-order transition, marked by a sharp sign-reversing superconducting diode effect. The altermagnetic field generates band-resolved competing pairing channels, giving rise to a double-valley free energy landscape whose global minimum switches discontinuously. It consequently leads to a first-order topological FFLO transition with simultaneous jumps in the Cooper pairing amplitude and finite center-of-mass momentum. Remarkably, this discontinuous topological reconfiguration substantially enhances the diode efficiency and drives a characteristic sharp sign reversal across the transition. The mechanism of such exotic phenomena is captured by Ginzburg--Landau theory. Our results provide a field-free altermagnetic route to topological FFLO states and identify their direct transport fingerprint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在自旋轨道耦合纳米线与d波交变磁体邻近效应中实现拓扑FFLO态的新机制，该相变为一级相变，伴随着超导二极管效应的符号反转，且不需要净 magnetization。
AI.motivation: 传统FFLO态通过有限磁化驱动的二级相变实现，本文旨在探索在零净磁化条件下能否实现拓扑FFLO态，并寻找其直接输运指纹。
AI.method: 理论分析自旋轨道耦合纳米线与d波交变磁体的邻近效应，利用Ginzburg-Landau理论描述自由能景观的双谷结构，研究一级相变和超导二极管效应的符号反转。
AI.result: 发现交变磁场产生能带分辨的竞争配对通道，形成双谷自由能景观，全局最小值发生不连续切换，导致一级拓扑FFLO相变，伴随Cooper对振幅和有限质心动量的同时跳变。该过程显著增强了二极管效率并驱动了特征性的符号反转。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种无需外磁场的交变磁体路径来实现拓扑FFLO态，并识别了其直接输运指纹——超导二极管效应的符号反转。

title: Loss of positive definiteness is a symptom, not the cause, of high-Weissenberg-number breakdown
summary: Numerical breakdown at high Weissenberg number is often attributed to loss of symmetric positive definiteness (SPD) of the conformation tensor. That conclusion follows from Maxwell-type models without solvent viscosity. With solvent fraction $β>0$, the initial-value problem is locally well posed for arbitrary symmetric stress. We derive the missing quantitative theory for indefinite states and test its computational consequences. Frozen-coefficient analysis gives a growth rate uniformly bounded in wavenumber and the direction-resolved instability threshold $λ_{\min}(A)<-β/(1-β)$; stress diffusion supplies a closed-form cutoff, while the classical $σ\propto k$ catastrophe is recovered as solvent viscosity vanishes. A determinant identity shows that violations self-heal on the timescale $λ/2$, so persistent violations measure the truncation error that recreates them. Spectral and lattice Boltzmann tests reproduce the threshold, solvent-fraction reversal, and resolution independence. In four-roll-mill interventions, enforcing SPD delays blow-up by 15 convective times but reduces the stagnation-point Weissenberg number by 30%. Across five coupling schemes, a local second-moment stress source remains stable through the full budget at $\mathrm{Wi}=50$ while carrying $\det A\approx-8.5\times10^5$; the divergence-coupled variant fails at $t^*=47$. The surviving scheme matches published benchmarks within 0.05% and 0.18% at $\mathrm{Wi}=10$ and 20. Thus loss of positive definiteness is neither necessary nor sufficient for breakdown: the discrete coupling route decides, and the violation is a resolution gauge for which we provide run-time monitors.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了高Weissenberg数下构象张量失去正定性是否导致数值崩溃的问题，发现其既非必要也非充分条件，真正决定因素在于离散耦合方式，并提出了一种基于应力扩散的定量理论和运行时监测指标。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为高Weissenberg数下的数值崩溃源于构象张量失去对称正定性（SPD），但这一结论基于无溶剂粘度的Maxwell模型。作者希望澄清在溶剂分数β>0的实际情况下，失去SPD是否真的是崩溃的根本原因，并建立相应的定量理论。
AI.method: 采用冻结系数分析推导无界增长率的条件，得到方向分辨的不稳定阈值 λ_min(A) < -β/(1-β)；利用行列式恒等式证明违反SPD的状态会在λ/2时间尺度上自愈；通过谱方法和晶格玻尔兹曼方法进行数值验证；对比五种不同的应力耦合方案。
AI.result: 失去了SPD的构象张量并不必然导致崩溃，最高可达λ_min≈-8.5×10^5仍稳定；强制保持SPD虽能将崩溃延迟15个对流时间单位，但会降低30%的驻点Weissenberg数；不同的离散耦合方案决定了稳定性，其中局部二阶矩应力源方案在Wi=50下全程稳定，而散度耦合方案在t*=47处失效。
AI.conclusion: 构象张量失去正定性既不是数值崩溃的必要条件也不是充分条件，真正起决定作用的是离散耦合方式。违反SPD的状态实际上是截断误差的量度，可作为运行时监测指标。

title: Fragmented ETH: Prethermalization, Timescales, and Ensemble Inequivalence
summary: We investigate how finite quantum systems with strong long-range interactions approach thermal equilibrium. Nearly conserved quantities inherited from the fully connected limit fragment the Hilbert space and give rise to a many-body spectrum split into energy bands. As a result, equilibration becomes anomalously slow and proceeds through long-lived prethermal plateaus. This two-stage equilibration process is, however, not universal. We uncover the mechanism that determines which observables and initial states exhibit, or evade, prethermal plateaus. We also develop a perturbative theory that provides analytical expressions for both the height of the prethermal plateau and its timescale. Despite the lack of global ergodicity, quantum chaos develops within individual energy bands, enabling the definition of microcanonical ensembles within the bands. This supports a band-resolved formulation of thermalization, which we term fragmented eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (fETH). Unlike conventional ETH, finite-size scaling in fETH obeys a symmetry-imposed selection rule that restricts which system sizes can be compared. This band-resolved description has direct consequences for equilibrium statistical mechanics. While microcanonical ensembles remain confined to a single band, canonical ensembles mix different bands. This mismatch explains ensemble inequivalence without invoking equilibrium phase transitions. Our results apply to a broad class of Hamiltonians exhibiting Hilbert-space fragmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有强长程相互作用的有限量子系统如何趋近热平衡。发现从全连极限继承的近守恒量会分割希尔伯特空间，产生分能带的多体谱，导致平衡过程异常缓慢并出现预热平台。作者揭示了哪些可观测量和初始态会表现出或规避预热平台，并发展了微扰理论给出平台高度和时间尺度的解析表达式。尽管全局非遍历，但能带内存在量子混沌，支持带分辨的微正则系综，提出了碎片化本征态热化假说(fETH)。该理论解释了系综不等价性，适用于广泛的存在希尔伯特空间碎片化的哈密顿量。
AI.motivation: 理解强长程相互作用量子系统中热平衡的趋近机制，特别是希尔伯特空间碎片化导致的两阶段平衡过程及其普适性。
AI.method: 通过分析近守恒量导致的能带结构，结合微扰理论推导预热平台高度和时间尺度，提出带分辨的碎片化本征态热化假说(fETH)，并利用对称性约束的有限尺寸标度分析。
AI.result: 发现平衡过程分为两阶段(预热平台+最终平衡)；明确了预热平台出现的条件；给出了平台高度和时间尺度的解析表达式；建立了带内量子混沌与fETH框架；揭示了微正则系综与正则系综的带分辨差异导致系综不等价性。
AI.conclusion: 希尔伯特空间碎片化导致非普适的两阶段平衡过程；fETH修正了传统ETH，并解释了系综不等价性的新机制，该理论广泛适用于存在碎片化的哈密顿量系统。

title: Nanoscale stray fields from micromagnets for optimal spin qubit architecture
summary: On-chip micromagnets generate local magnetic-field asymmetries, enabling electrical control of spin qubits via electric dipole spin resonance and their integration into circuit quantum electrodynamics (QED) architectures. Accurate prediction of spin-qubit performance requires modeling micromagnet stray fields beyond the saturated-magnet approximation, accounting for nonuniform magnetization. Here, we combine thin-film characterization of Co, Co/Ta multilayers, and CoFe films with nanoscale stray-field measurements using NV-center magnetometry in the unsaturated regime to establish a reliable micromagnetic simulation framework. We show that CoFe micromagnets generate antisymmetric fields in double quantum-dot geometries exceeding +/- 100mT, owing to their high saturation magnetization and favorable magnetocrystalline anisotropy. For spin qubits coupled to microwave resonators, the predicted spin-photon coupling reaches $\left| g_s/g_c \right| \approx 0.5$, where $g_c$ denotes the charge-photon coupling strength of the underlying charge qubit, highlighting the potential for high-fidelity operations in circuit QED architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合薄膜表征和NV中心磁测量，建立了超越饱和磁化近似的微磁模拟框架，证明CoFe微磁体能在双量子点结构中产生超过±100 mT的反对称场，并预测自旋-光子耦合强度可达|g_s/g_c|≈0.5，展示了在电路QED架构中实现高保真度操作的潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有微磁体建模通常采用饱和磁化近似，忽略非均匀磁化效应，导致自旋量子比特性能预测不准确。因此需要建立更可靠的微磁模拟框架，精确预测微磁体杂散场分布。
AI.method: 结合薄膜表征技术（Co、Co/Ta多层膜、CoFe薄膜）与NV色心磁测量技术，在非饱和磁化区域进行纳米级杂散场测量，建立可靠的微磁模拟框架。
AI.result: CoFe微磁体在双量子点结构中产生超过±100 mT的反对称场；自旋-光子耦合强度预测达到|g_s/g_c|≈0.5。
AI.conclusion: 所建立的微磁模拟框架可准确预测微磁体性能，CoFe材料因高饱和磁化强度和良好的磁晶各向异性，在电路QED架构中具有实现高保真度自旋量子比特操作的潜力。

title: Spontaneous Nanopatterning and Strain Relaxation in SiGe Layers Grown by Oxidative Solid Phase Epitaxy
comment: Main text: 17 pages, 5 figures. Supporting information: 11 pages, 6 figures
summary: The wafer-scale monolithic integration of III-V materials on Si would lead to revolutionary optoelectronic hardware for data, computing and other applications. However, heteroepitaxy of III-Vs on Si requires overcoming the large lattice and thermal mismatches between the materials and reducing threading dislocations densities. In this work, we explore the oxidative solid phase epitaxy (SPE) of Ge+ implanted Si(111) to form ultra-thin strain-relieving SiGe metamorphic buffer layers for heteroepitaxy on Si. The SPE process is shown to result in a nanopatterning of the Ge concentration variation across the sample surface, visible by scanning and transmission electron microscopy (SEM and TEM). The concentration patterning is the result of a hexagonal network of Shockley partial dislocations at the SiGe/Si interface. Analyzing the pattern spacing observed by SEM is demonstrated as an easy, non-destructive method for obtaining the local strain state of SiGe layers. This work is important for engineering ultra-thin SiGe metamorphic buffer layers for III-V optoelectronics heteroepitaxy on the silicon platform.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了通过氧化固相外延（SPE）在Si(111)上形成超薄SiGe应变缓冲层，发现Ge浓度在表面形成六角形网状图案，并证明可通过SEM非破坏性评估局部应变状态，对III-V/Si异质集成具有重要意义。
AI.motivation: 实现III-V材料在Si上的晶圆级单片集成需要克服大的晶格和热失配、降低穿透位错密度，因此需要高效的应变缓冲层。
AI.method: 在Si(111)衬底上进行Ge+离子注入，通过氧化固相外延（SPE）形成超薄SiGe应变缓冲层，利用SEM和TEM表征微观结构。
AI.result: SPE过程导致Ge浓度在表面形成六角形网状图案，该图案源于SiGe/Si界面处的Shockley不全位错六角网络；通过SEM分析图案间距可非破坏性地获得SiGe层局部应变状态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为工程化用于III-V/Si异质外延的超薄SiGe变质缓冲层提供了重要方法，有助于推动硅基光电子集成。

title: Data-efficient reconstruction of critical quantum dynamics via blind fractional-envelope extrapolation
summary: Simulating real-time dynamics of quantum systems is often limited to short times by entanglement growth. Finite-pole reconstructions such as linear prediction and related machineries extrapolate such data reliably when the spectrum is a finite set of excitations, but at criticality the low-energy spectrum is a power-law continuum $A(ω)\sim|ω|^{α-1}$ -- a branch cut whose real-time tail $G(t)\sim t^{-α}$ finitely many poles cannot represent. Here we develop a fractional-calculus-motivated envelope extrapolation for such data. Its structure is motivated by a fractional form of Schwinger--Dyson (fSD) equation, in which the Laplace symbol $s^α$ carries the branch cut analytically while the residual self-energy remains meromorphic. On real data we employ the corresponding operational alternative -- the exponent $α$ is selected blindly inside the fit window, the signal is detrended by $t^α$, the residual is fitted by a stabilized finite-pole model, and the algebraic envelope is restored. On the critical XXZ chain this blind fractional-envelope method (fSD for short) extrapolates short-time data typically several-fold more accurately than finite-pole methods, with the exponent $α$ identified blindly from the fit window alone and bracketing the closed-form Luttinger value at weak coupling. The same blind search finds the $z=2$ dilute-magnon exponent $α=1/2$ at the $Δ=1$ saturation transition, and the advantage persists in the gapped free-magnon phase with its sharp band edges. On noncritical dynamical mean-field spectra, whose low-frequency response is regular, fSD by contrast fails to select any stable fractional envelope and reduces to the standard pole result rather than manufacturing a spurious power law, making it an efficient and accurate route to quantum critical dynamics when only short simulation times are accessible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分数阶微积分的包络外推法(fSD)，用于从短时量子模拟数据中准确提取临界动力学信息。该方法通过$t^α$去趋势、残差有限极点拟合、代数包络恢复的流程，在XXZ链等临界系统中显著优于传统有限极点方法，并能盲选指数$α$，同时在非临界系统中自动回归标准极点结果，避免虚假幂律。
AI.motivation: 量子系统实时动力学模拟常因纠缠增长而局限于短时间。有限极点重构方法在离散谱下表现良好，但在临界点附近低频谱呈幂律连续谱(枝割)，仅用有限极点无法表示其时域拖尾$G(t)\sim t^{-α}$。因此需要一种能够处理枝割结构的外推方法。
AI.method: 受分数阶Schwinger-Dyson(fSD)方程启发，在拉普拉斯域中用$s^α$解析承载枝割，保留残差异构函数为亚纯函数。在实际操作中：盲选指数$α$，对信号做$t^α$去趋势，用稳定化有限极点模型拟合残差，最后恢复代数包络。
AI.result: 在临界XXZ链上，fSD方法比有限极点方法准确数倍；盲选的$α$与Luttinger理论值一致；在$Δ=1$饱和转变处找到$z=2$稀磁激子指数$α=1/2$；在能隙自由磁子相中也有优势。在非临界DMFT谱中，fSD不会制造虚假幂律，自动退化为标准极点结果。
AI.conclusion: fSD方法为短时模拟数据中的量子临界动力学提供了一条高效、准确的路径，能区分临界与非临界行为，在仅能获得短时模拟数据的场景下具有重要应用价值。

title: Contactless terahertz mapping of wafer-scale superconducting NbTiN thin films
summary: For large-scale superconducting quantum technology, e.g. quantum computing, the homogeneity of wafer-scale superconducting thin films is vital for consistent performance of the fabricated devices. Terahertz (THz) spectroscopy as a contactless and non-destructive measurement technique is a powerful tool to characterize the superconducting films. In this work, a set of niobium titanium nitride (NbTiN) thin films on 4-inch and 6-inch silicon wafers, grown via plasma-enhanced magnetron sputtering, are investigated via THz spectroscopy: full wafers are mapped at room temperatures and exemplary segments are characterized at cryogenic temperatures. The deviations in observed sheet resistance depend on the used deposition device and the film thickness. While the deviations in superconducting sheet kinetic inductance match those of the normal-state sheet resistance, the critical temperature and energy gap exhibit little variation. This THz mapping technique demonstrates the feasibility of evaluating wafer-scale superconducting thin films before lithography, facilitating preparation of the thin films for reproducible device fabrication.

AI.tldr: 本文利用太赫兹光谱技术对4英寸和6英寸晶圆上的NbTiN超导薄膜进行无接触表征，发现正常态方块电阻与超导态动能电感的偏差一致，而临界温度和能隙变化较小，证明该方法可在光刻前评估晶圆级超导薄膜的均匀性。
AI.motivation: 大规模超导量子技术（如量子计算）中，晶圆级超导薄膜的均匀性对器件一致性至关重要，亟需一种非接触、无损的薄膜表征方法。
AI.method: 采用太赫兹光谱技术对等离子体增强磁控溅射生长的NbTiN薄膜进行室温全晶圆映射和低温局部表征，测量其太赫兹响应以提取电学参数。
AI.result: 方块电阻的偏差与沉积设备和膜厚相关；超导态动能电感的偏差与正常态方块电阻一致；临界温度和能隙变化较小。
AI.conclusion: 太赫兹映射技术能够在光刻前有效评估晶圆级超导薄膜的均匀性，有助于实现可重复的器件制备。

title: Atomic Design Transformer: Scaffold-Conditioned 3D Molecule Generation via xTB-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary:
We present an SE(3)-invariant transformer for 3D-molecule generation,
  the Atomic Design Transformer (ADT). ADT places atoms one
  at a time, autoregressively. SE(3) invariance is achieved by
  tokenization: each new atom's position is encoded in the local
  coordinate frame of a previously placed atom. The backbone is a plain
  causal transformer. The token stream fully specifies a 3D structure
  together with its chemical-bond graph G, without any bond-order
  assignment. To score generated molecules we introduce the xTB
  topology-preservation rate (XTP): the fraction of molecules for
  which an xTB GFN2 relaxation preserves G specified by the token stream.
  For XTP-accepted molecules we also report the
  relaxation energy and the root mean square of the atomic displacement (RMSD). We evaluate
  two ADT models. The first is ADT pretrained on the GEOM-Drugs
  $\le\!30$-heavy-atom dataset; we benchmark scaffold-conditioned 3D
  generation across seven drug-like scaffolds from the model. It
  reaches an XTP of ${\sim}54\%$ and a valid-molecule yield
  $N^{\mathrm{gen}}/N$ of ${\sim}50\%$, where $N^{\mathrm{gen}}/N$ is the
  fraction of samples that are distinct, topology-preserving, and
  chemically valid. The second model continues from the first by
  reinforcement learning against the verifiable xTB reward (RLVR), using
  no external molecules. RLVR raises XTP to ${\sim}98\%$ and
  $N^{\mathrm{gen}}/N$ to ${\sim}95\%$, while approximately preserving the
  GEOM-Drugs size and composition distributions. Finally, we present
  an Inverse-Kinematics Transformer that recovers XTP for large molecules, where discretization error accumulates. ADT thus enables direct 3D generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Atomic Design Transformer (ADT)，一个SE(3)等变自回归3D分子生成模型，通过局部坐标系编码原子位置实现等变性。结合xTB拓扑保持率(XTP)评估，并引入强化学习(RLVR)将XTP从~54%提升至~98%，有效生成有效3D分子结构。
AI.motivation: 现有3D分子生成方法难以同时保证SE(3)等变性和生成质量，且缺乏对生成分子拓扑结构保持性的有效评估指标。作者旨在设计一个可直接生成3D分子结构、保持拓扑一致性的高效模型。
AI.method: 1) ADT采用自回归方式逐个放置原子，通过局部坐标系（已放置原子上）编码新原子位置实现SE(3)不变性。2) 使用纯因果Transformer处理token序列，token流同时编码3D结构和化学键图G。3) 提出xTB拓扑保持率(XTP)评估指标。4) 引入基于可验证xTB奖励的强化学习(RLVR)微调模型。
AI.result: 在GEOM-Drugs ≤30重原子数据集上，预训练ADT达到~54% XTP和~50%有效分子率。经RLVR微调后，XTP提升至~98%，有效分子率提升至~95%，同时保持尺寸和组成分布。还提出逆运动学Transformer处理大分子离散误差问题。
AI.conclusion: ADT成功实现了直接高效的3D分子生成，结合XTP评估和RLVR优化策略，显著提升了生成分子的拓扑保持性和化学有效性，为3D分子生成领域提供了新的有效范式。

title: Scaling regimes of the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation from the functional renormalization group
summary: We revisit the renormalization group (RG) approach to the one-dimensional stochastic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation and show that previous approaches based on perturbative Wilsonian RG with a sharp cutoff are not valid, even though they yield a qualitatively correct picture. The reason is that taking momentum derivatives while using the sharp cutoff is not well-defined in some cases and leads to intrinsic divergencies. This is a well-known problem of Wilsonian RG, which can be simply cured by using a smooth cutoff, and employing the functional renormalization group (FRG) framework. We establish the flow equations for the KS model within the FRG, and demonstrate that it flows to the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) fixed point at large scales. We then calculate the full two-point correlation function over a wide range of momenta and frequencies. We show that it exhibits three universal scaling regimes that we characterize: the KPZ regime (with dynamical exponent $z=3/2$), the Edwards-Wilkinson regime (with $z=2$) and the recently discovered inviscid regime (with $z=1$). The latter develops over an extended range of large wavenumbers and originates from the vanishing of the effective viscosity. Lastly, we investigate the large-scale behavior of the deterministic KS equation by studying the limit of vanishing noise and we determine the scales where the KPZ regime can emerge in the deterministic case.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了一维随机Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程的重整化群方法，指出基于尖锐截断的微扰Wilson RG存在内在发散问题，转而采用光滑截断的功能性重整化群（FRG）框架，建立了KS模型的流方程。研究表明系统在大尺度下流向KPZ不动点，并揭示了三个普适标度区域：KPZ区（z=3/2）、Edwards-Wilkinson区（z=2）和无粘区（z=1）。无粘区起源于有效粘度的消失，在较大波数范围内发展。最后研究了确定性KS方程的大尺度行为及KPZ区出现的条件。
AI.motivation: 先前基于尖锐截断的微扰Wilson RG方法在处理一维随机Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程时存在数学上的内在发散问题（动量导数定义不良好），因此需要采用更严格的功能性重整化群（FRG）框架来正确描述该系统的标度行为。
AI.method: 采用光滑截断的功能性重整化群（FRG）框架，建立KS模型的流方程，通过计算全波数-频率范围内的两点关联函数，分析系统的标度行为。
AI.result: （1）系统在大尺度下流向KPZ不动点；（2）发现三个普适标度区域：KPZ区（z=3/2）、Edwards-Wilkinson区（z=2）和新发现的无粘区（z=1）；（3）无粘区起源于有效粘度的消失，在较大波数范围内扩展；（4）确定了确定性KS方程中KPZ区出现的尺度条件。
AI.conclusion: FRG方法能有效克服传统Wilson RG尖锐截断的内在发散问题，为KS方程提供了严格的重整化群描述。KS方程展现丰富的标度行为，包含三个普适类。无粘区（z=1）的发现为理解系统在高波数区的动力学行为提供了新视角。

title: Dynamical Polarization from Hidden Spin and Orbital Textures in p-Wave Magnets
summary: Period-averaged descriptions often miss essential features of driven quantum matter. We show that the micromotion of an optically driven $p$-wave magnet unveils a hidden net spin polarization, absent from both the equilibrium and period-averaged spin textures, which remain odd in momentum. This spin polarization oscillates at the drive frequency and is resonantly enhanced at the interband gap set by nonrelativistic exchange splitting. The drive further activates an orbital angular momentum governed by interband quantum geometry. While its linear response remains momentum-odd, nonlinear rectification yields a static, momentum-even orbital polarization for suitably oriented driving fields. These results establish $p$-wave magnets as a source of resonant ac spin and rectified dc orbital polarization: effects invisible to any period-averaged treatment.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了光驱动p波磁体中的微观运动会产生隐藏的自旋极化和轨道角动量，这些效应在周期平均描述中完全缺失，包括共振交流自旋极化和整流直流轨道极化。
AI.motivation: 周期平均描述无法捕捉驱动量子物质的关键特征，作者旨在揭示光驱动下p波磁体中隐藏的物理效应。
AI.method: 通过分析光驱动p波磁体的微观运动，研究自旋极化和轨道角动量的动力学响应，包括线性响应和非线性整流效应。
AI.result: 发现了共振增强的交流自旋极化（依赖于交换分裂的带间能隙）和静态的动量-偶轨道极化（通过非线性整流实现）。
AI.conclusion: p波磁体可作为共振交流自旋和整流直流轨道极化的来源，这些效应在周期平均处理中完全不可见。

title: Phase-Field Simulation of Dendrite Evolution in All-Solid-State Sodium Batteries during Cycling
summary: Dendrite growth during cycling remains a critical challenge for all-solid-state batteries (SSBs), limiting the full realization of their inherent safety and high energy density. In particular, the mechanisms of continuous dendrite penetration during charge-discharge cycling remain poorly understood and are difficult to characterize experimentally. This study applies a phase-field model, informed by density functional theory calculations, to rationalize and visualize the dendrite penetration behaviors during cycling in sodium (Na) SSBs with pure Na or Na-Sb alloy anodes and polycrystalline Na$_3$SbS$_4$ electrolyte. We show that dendrite stripping is intrinsically asymmetric with respect to plating due to grain boundary geometry, leading to the formation of isolated Na metal that persists between cycles. This residual Na metal becomes kinetically stabilized at grain-boundary junctions and is readily reactivated during subsequent plating, thereby accelerating and amplifying dendrite penetration. We further investigate the effects of applied voltage, solid-electrolyte microstructure, and anode chemistry on this phenomenon. These findings establish isolated Na metal as a key contributor for continued dendrite propagation in Na SSBs and provide design principles for stabilizing anode/electrolyte interfaces in Na SSBs.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过相场模型和密度泛函理论计算，揭示了钠全固态电池中枝晶在循环过程中持续穿透的机制：枝晶剥离相对于沉积具有内在不对称性，导致残余钠金属在晶界处形成并稳定存在，进而在后续沉积中被重新激活，加速枝晶穿透。研究还探讨了电压、电解质微观结构和负极化学性质的影响，为稳定负极/电解质界面提供了设计原则。
AI.motivation: 全固态电池中枝晶生长是限制其安全性和高能量密度的关键挑战，但循环过程中枝晶持续穿透的机制尚不明确且难以通过实验表征，因此亟需理论模型来理解这一现象。
AI.method: 采用基于密度泛函理论计算的相场模型，模拟了使用纯Na或Na-Sb合金负极和多晶Na₃SbS₄电解质的钠全固态电池在循环过程中的枝晶穿透行为。
AI.result: 发现枝晶剥离相对于沉积具有内在不对称性，导致孤立Na金属在晶界交汇处形成并动力学稳定化，这些残余Na在后续沉积中被重新激活，加速并放大了枝晶穿透。电压、电解质微观结构和负极化学性质均会影响该现象。
AI.conclusion: 确定了孤立Na金属是钠全固态电池中枝晶持续传播的关键因素，为稳定负极/电解质界面提供了设计原则。

title: Topology and compact molecular orbitals in twisted bilayer WSe$_2$
summary: Recent observations of superconductivity in twisted bilayer WSe$_2$ (tWSe$_2$) have motivated theoretical proposals for unconventional pairing mechanisms. A central question is whether band topology plays an essential role in the system's correlation physics. In this letter, we develop a first-principles-based description of the top moiré valence bands in tWSe$_2$. Using density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we identify the bands in the relevant range of twist angles to be topologically non-trivial, with the top valence bands carrying Chern numbers $C=(+1,+1)$ for the $K$ valley. In order to treat the strong correlation physics, we construct compact molecular orbitals directly from the DFT wave functions through a partial Wannierization procedure and with the guidance of spinful $C_{3z}$ symmetry representations. This yields a localized $f$ orbital together with a complementary topological $c$ orbital, allowing us to extract hopping and hybridization amplitudes from first principles. The resulting parameters provide an ab initio benchmark for the effective Hamiltonian. Our work establishes a foundation for understanding superconductivity in moiré TMDs and highlights tWSe$_2$ as a promising platform for exploring topological superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算揭示了扭曲双层WSe₂中顶层moire价带的拓扑非平庸性质（Chern数C=+1,+1），并构建了紧束缚模型以建立超导理论研究的基准。
AI.motivation: 探究tWSe₂中能带拓扑是否对其强关联物理和非常规超导配对机制起关键作用。
AI.method: 基于DFT计算识别能带拓扑，通过部分Wannier化程序结合自旋C₃z对称性表示，构建局域f轨道与拓扑c轨道，提取第一性原理的跳跃与杂化参数。
AI.result: 顶层价带在K谷携带Chern数C=(+1,+1)，属于拓扑非平庸能带；成功提取出有效的紧束缚模型参数。
AI.conclusion: 为理解tWSe₂的超导机理提供了第一性原理基准，并指出tWSe₂是探索拓扑超导的 promising 平台。

title: Drosophila of phonon-mediated superconductivity: Full Eliashberg theory of the jellium model
summary: We present a full numerical solution of the Migdal--Eliashberg equations for the jellium model of phonon-mediated superconductivity. We find very low critical temperatures below 1~K, in contrast to earlier claims that the jellium model for hydrogen solids might reach room-temperature superconductivity. Our results suggest that full momentum and frequency dependence of the gap function and normal self-energy should be taken into account for accurate $T_c$ estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过完全数值求解Migdla-Eliashberg方程，发现胶体模型下超导临界温度低于1K，反驳了此前关于该模型可能实现室温超导的观点。
AI.motivation: 此前有研究声称胶体模型（特别是氢固体）可能实现室温超导，但该结论可能由于对能隙函数和正常自能的动量-频率依赖性考虑不足而存在偏差。
AI.method: 完全数值求解Migdla-Eliashberg方程，完整考虑能隙函数和正常自能的动量与频率依赖。
AI.result: 临界温度（Tc）低于1K，远低于室温。
AI.conclusion: 准确估算Tc必须充分考虑能隙函数和正常自能的完整动量与频率依赖性；胶体模型无法实现室温超导。

title: CADAQUES: A Cost-Aware Dual Architecture for Query-Efficient Autonomous Discovery
summary: Autonomous discovery systems couple a resource that answers queries (a simulator, instrument, or analytic model) to an algorithm that selects what to query next. Most software frameworks for this loop inherit the control structure of numerical optimization: campaigns run for a fixed number of iterations, query costs are absent from the programming interface, and decision-making is treated as free. In practice, queries may differ in cost by orders of magnitude, and planners built on large language models or expensive surrogates consume resources of their own. Here we present CADAQUES, an open-source Python framework built on one architectural principle: cost is a first-class primitive of the discovery loop. CADAQUES separates the loop into two structural protocols, an Oracle that answers queries and a Driver that proposes them, and charges both evaluations and decisions against a common vector-valued budget spanning wall time, CPU hours, monetary cost, and language model tokens. An append-only ledger records, for each transaction, the cost declared before execution and the cost settled afterwards, making their discrepancy an observable property of the campaign. We evaluate the architecture by locating the critical temperature of the two-dimensional Ising model from noisy finite-size estimates against the exact thermodynamic-limit reference. In this noisy setting, strategies that concentrate around the best observed result can be misled by noise-induced peaks, whereas a schedule that explores with cheap low-fidelity queries and refines with higher-fidelity ones yields lower and less variable errors than high fidelity throughout, at the studied budget scale. Metering adds tens of microseconds per iteration, three orders of magnitude below the cheapest oracle query. The framework is MIT-licensed and archived at Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21293589).

AI.tldr: 本文提出CADAQUES，一个将成本作为一等公民的开源Python自主发现框架。它将发现循环分为Oracle（回答查询）和Driver（提出查询）两个协议，使用向量化预算追踪多种成本（墙钟时间、CPU小时、货币成本、LLM token），并通过不可变账本记录成本声明与结算之间的差异。
AI.motivation: 现有自主发现系统继承自数值优化控制结构，固定迭代次数、忽略查询成本差异、将决策视为免费。然而实际中查询成本可能相差数个数量级，基于大语言模型或昂贵代理的规划器本身也消耗大量资源。
AI.method: CADAQUES框架将成本作为一等公民：1) 分离Oracle（回答查询）与Driver（提出查询）两个协议；2) 使用向量化预算（墙钟时间、CPU小时、货币成本、LLM token）统一计量评估与决策的开销；3) 采用仅追加账本记录每次交易的声明成本与结算成本。
AI.result: 在二维Ising模型临界温度定位任务上，噪声环境下探索性低保真查询+精炼性高保真查询的策略优于全程高保真策略，误差更低且方差更小。计量开销每迭代仅数十微秒，比最便宜的Oracle查询低三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 成本感知的架构设计对自主发现系统至关重要，将成本作为编程接口的一等公民能够支持更高效、更鲁棒的实验策略。

title: Ultrametric organization of energy landscapes on random Erdős--Rényi graphs: topological origin of barrier hierarchy
summary: We investigate the ultrametric organization of energy landscapes defined on sparse random Erdős--Rényi graphs. Each graph vertex is assigned a random free energy from a uniform distribution over an interval of width $ΔF$, and the kinetics are modeled by a Markov process with Kramers transition rates. Using spectral decomposition of the rate matrix, we construct a kinetic Mahalanobis metric between basins of attraction. Computational experiments for graphs with $V=5000$ vertices and $E=5000$ edges show that the degree of nontrivial ultrametricity increases monotonically from $\approx42\%$ for $ΔF=10$ kJ/mol to $\approx96\%$ for $ΔF=1000$ kJ/mol. We prove a limit theorem: as $ΔF\to\infty$, the logarithmic asymptotics of this metric converge pointwise to the classical single-linkage ultrametric. For finite $ΔF$, corrections from suboptimal paths are exponentially suppressed with increasing $ΔF$, so that the metric becomes asymptotically ultrametric. Our results suggest that ultrametricity is a universal property of sparse, locally tree-like networks with rugged energy landscapes in the limit of large energy spreads.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稀疏随机Erdős–Rényi图上能量景观的超度量组织。通过谱分解构建动力学马氏度量，数值实验表明超度量性随能量分布宽度ΔF增加而单调增强（42%→96%）。证明当ΔF→∞时，该度量的对数渐近收敛于经典单链超度量，揭示了稀疏树状网络上超度量性在大能量扩散极限下的普适性。
AI.motivation: 探索稀疏随机图上能量景观的超度量组织特性，理解复杂能量景观中动力学过程的度量结构，特别是能量扩散宽度对超度量性质的影响。
AI.method: 在Erdős–Rényi随机图上分配均匀分布的自由能，利用Kramers跃迁速率建模动力学Markov过程，通过率矩阵的谱分解构造吸引域之间的动力学马氏度量。进行了V=5000顶点、E=5000边的计算实验，并给出了极限定理证明。
AI.result: 超度量程度随ΔF从10 kJ/mol到1000 kJ/mol单调递增（≈42%→≈96%）。证明当ΔF→∞时度量对数渐近收敛于单链超度量；有限ΔF下次优路径的修正被指数级压制。
AI.conclusion: 超度量性是稀疏、局部树状网络在能量扩散极限下的普适属性，为理解复杂能量景观的动力学结构提供了理论支撑。

title: Hot-Carrier Distribution Spectroscopy by Transconductance in Two-Dimensional Field-Effect Transistors
summary: The transconductance $g_m = dI_D/dV_G$ of a field-effect transistor (FET) is conventionally read as a proxy for carrier density. We show that it is instead a spectroscopic probe of the carrier distribution: because $g_m$ weights the spectral current $j(E)$ by the gate-voltage derivative $\partial f(E)/\partial V_G$ and integrates over energy, it is sensitive to the \emph{shape} of $f(E)$, not merely its integrated weight $n$. We develop an energy-resolved transport framework for two-dimensional (2D) FETs and, within a gate-independent spectral-kernel approximation, derive the decomposition $g_m = g_m^{(n)} + g_m^{(α)}$ into the conventional density-modulation term $g_m^{(n)}$ and a distribution-shape-driven term $g_m^{(α)}$. The latter, obtained as the residual after subtracting the smooth density-modulation background from the measured $g_m$, exhibits a characteristic anomalous peak at a gate voltage $V_G^{\rm pk}$. This peak has no counterpart in equilibrium transport and \emph{cannot be explained by carrier density modulation alone}. With the spectral kernel calibrated, the peak position and height -- extracted from standard DC/lock-in $g_m$ sweeps -- constrain the hot-carrier energy $E_0$, spectral width $σ$, and generation threshold $n_c$, realizing a steady-state, all-electrical spectroscopy of the carrier distribution. An optional time-resolved extension further recovers the carrier relaxation time $τ$ from the transient response following a pump excitation, establishing the 2D FET as a distribution-function spectrometer that requires no optical readout.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示FET的跨导gm并非传统认为的载流子密度探针，而是载流子分布的光谱探针。通过推导出gm = gm^(n) + gm^(α)的分解，其中gm^(α)项源自分布形状变化，在特定栅压下出现异常峰，可用于提取热载流子能量、谱宽等参数，实现全电学载流子分布光谱分析。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将FET跨导gm视为载流子密度的简单代理，但作者发现gm实际上对载流子分布的形状敏感，因此需要重新理解gm的物理含义，并开发基于此的新型光谱表征方法。
AI.method: 建立二维FET的能量分辨输运框架，在栅压无关的谱核近似下推导出gm = gm^(n) + gm^(α)分解；通过扣除平滑的密度调制背景获得gm^(α)残差项；利用标准DC/锁相gm扫描提取异常峰特征参数；并扩展时间分辨方案恢复载流子弛豫时间。
AI.result: 发现gm^(α)项在特定栅压V_G^pk处出现异常峰，该峰无法由载流子密度调制解释；通过校准谱核，可从峰位和峰高中提取热载流子能量E0、谱宽σ和产生阈值nc；时间分辨扩展可恢复载流子弛豫时间τ。
AI.conclusion: FET的gm可作为稳态全电学载流子分布光谱仪，无需光学读出，实现了分布函数的电学表征新范式。

title: Ab initio time-dependent GW approach for nonequilibrium exciton-phonon coupled dynamics across momentum space
summary: The dynamics of optical excitations in materials generally involves intertwined electron-hole (e-h) and electron-phonon (e-ph) interactions out of equilibrium. However, a full theoretical description of such nonequilibrium dynamics requires a systematic treatment of the coherent excitonic excitations and exciton-phonon interactions across the entire crystal momentum space in real time, which remains a major challenge and out of reach for first-principles approaches. Here, we present a new ab initio time-dependent adiabatic GW methodology that incorporates full finite-momentum e-h and e-ph couplings, enabling real-time simulations of the coherently coupled exciton-phonon dynamics. The excitonic excitations are naturally described by the equation of motion of the interacting single-particle density matrix, whereas their couplings to phonons are formulated within a linear-response framework, hence the simulations can be efficiently carried out within a primitive unit cell. We demonstrate the capabilities of this new approach by investigating the direct-to-indirect exciton transitions in monolayer WSe2 in a pump-probe setup of time-resolved and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Our results reveal that the phonon-mediated ultrafast intervalley dynamics of excitons of this system is within ~0.5 ps, manifested as in-gap photoemission intensity transfer from the K-valley to the Q-valley. This work establishes a comprehensive and practical nonequilibrium Green's function framework for accurately simulating nonequilibrium and coherent excitations involving coupled excitons and phonons from first principles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的从头算含时绝热GW方法，能够在实空间中实时模拟耦合的激子-声子动力学，并通过单层WSe₂中直接-间接激子转变的泵浦-探测实验验证了该方法，揭示了~0.5ps内的超快谷间激子动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有理论方法无法在实时、全动量空间内系统性地处理非平衡态下激子-声子耦合动力学，第一性原理方法面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 发展了含时绝热GW方法，通过相互作用单粒子密度矩阵的运动方程描述激子激发，在线性响应框架下处理激子-声子耦合，可在原胞内高效模拟。
AI.result: 在单层WSe₂中观察到K谷到Q谷的声子介导超快谷间激子动力学，时间尺度约为0.5 ps，表现为带隙内光电子发射强度从K谷转移到Q谷。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一个全面的非平衡格林函数框架，可精确地从第一性原理模拟激子-声子耦合系统中的非平衡与相干激发动力学。

title: Machine-learning test of the single-ion model for $dd$ excitations in cuprates
summary: We investigate $dd$ excitations in Resonant Inelastic X-ray Scattering spectra of YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_6$ and La$_2$CuO$_4$ using the local single-ion model. The data are analyzed by conventional global fitting and by a convolutional neural network trained within the same theoretical framework. For YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_6$, the excited state energies obtained with the two methods coincide, leading to the $xy$, $3z^2-r^2$, $xz/yz$ sequence for increasing energy. This result validates the use of machine learning tools for the analysis of RIXS spectra dominated by $dd$ excitations. By contrast, for La$_2$CuO$_4$, the two methods do not converge to a single solution, revealing the limitations of the single-ion model in describing $dd$ excitations in cuprates and pointing to the role of additional contributions beyond a purely local picture in shaping high-energy excitations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用局域单离子模型分析YBa₂Cu₃O₆和La₂CuO₄的RIXS光谱中的dd激发，分别采用传统全局拟合和卷积神经网络方法。对于YBa₂Cu₃O₆，两种方法结果一致，验证了机器学习工具在RIXS分析中的有效性；而对于La₂CuO₄，两种方法无法收敛到统一解，揭示了单离子模型的局限性，表明需考虑超越局域图像的额外贡献。
AI.motivation: 探索机器学习工具（卷积神经网络）在分析RIXS光谱中dd激发的可行性，并检验局域单离子模型在不同铜氧化物体系中的适用性。
AI.method: 采用局域单离子模型分析RIXS光谱，分别使用传统全局拟合和卷积神经网络两种方法进行数据处理和对比。
AI.result: 对于YBa₂Cu₃O₆，两种方法得到一致的激发态能量序列（xy, 3z²-r², xz/yz），验证了机器学习方法的有效性。对于La₂CuO₄，两种方法无法收敛到同一解。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习工具可有效用于RIXS光谱中dd激发分析，但局域单离子模型在描述某些铜氧化物（如La₂CuO₄）时存在局限性，高能激发可能涉及超越局域图像的额外贡献。

title: Coherent driving of displacive Higgs fluctuations in superconductors
summary: Intense phase-stable terahertz (THz) laser pulses can drive collective modes coherently via multi-photon excitation pathways in a manner different than the standard resonant mechanism operative in linear response. Here we show that in superconductors the nonlinear optical response can be enhanced when excited quasiparticles activate a (non-resonant) static displacement of the superconducting order parameter, in full analogy with the displacive excitation of coherent phonons in opaque materials. By combining numerical simulations with analytical results we demonstrate that the displacive mechanism to excite the Higgs mode is operative in both $s$-wave and $d$-wave superconductors. We validate this prediction experimentally by the temperature dependence of the phase of the nonlinear first harmonic in superconducting $s$-wave NbN. We also discuss how the order-parameter relaxation at large times, which can be experimentally accessed via pump-probe protocols is connected to energy-dissipative processes. Our results offer a novel perspective on the ability of intense THz fields to measure, and eventually control, the parametric dependence of the optical response on collective degrees of freedom.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了超导体中通过激发准粒子引起序参量静态位移的非线性光响应增强机制，该机制与不透明材料中相干声子的位移激发完全类似。通过数值模拟和解析结果证明，位移激发机制在s波和d波超导体中均能激发Higgs模，并通过s波NbN超导体的温度依赖实验验证了该预测。此外，还讨论了序参量在长时间尺度上的弛豫过程与能量耗散过程的关联。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在揭示超导体中一种不同于标准共振机制的集体模式激发路径——即通过多光子激发途径驱动非共振的序参量静态位移，从而激发Higgs模，并探索强太赫兹场在测量和控制超导光响应对集体自由度的参数依赖方面的能力。
AI.method: 结合数值模拟与解析结果，对s波和d波超导体中的位移激发Higgs模机制进行理论分析，并通过s波NbN超导体的非线性第一谐波相位随温度变化的实验进行验证。
AI.result: 证明了位移激发机制在s波和d波超导体中均可有效激发Higgs模；实验上在NbN中观察到与理论预测一致的温度依赖行为；揭示了序参量长时间弛豫与能量耗散过程的联系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为理解强太赫兹场下超导体的非线性光响应提供了新视角，特别是通过位移机制激发Higgs模的普适性，并为利用太赫兹场测量和控制超导集体自由度开辟了新途径。

title: exa-PD: A scalable high-performance workflow for multi-element phase diagram construction
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. The source code associated with this work is available at https://github.com/ML-AMD/exa-pd
summary: Exa-PD is a highly parallelizable workflow designed for the construction of multi-element phase diagrams (PDs). It uses standard sampling techniques, molecular dynamics (MD) and Monte Carlo (MC) as implemented in the LAMMPS package, to simultaneously sample multiple phases over a fine temperature-composition mesh for free-energy calculations. Parsl serves as the global workflow engine, coordinating large ensembles of MD and MC tasks to achieve massive parallelization with strong scalability. The resulting free energies of liquid and solid phases are then fed to CALPHAD modeling via the PyCalphad package to construct multi-element PDs.

AI.tldr: Exa-PD是一个高度可并行化的工作流，利用Parsl引擎协调LAMMPS中的MD和MC任务，在精细温度-成分网格上采样计算自由能，再通过PyCalphad进行CALPHAD建模，以构建多元素相图。
AI.motivation: 传统多元素相图构建计算成本高、并行化困难，需要一种可扩展的高效工作流来加速相图计算。
AI.method: 采用Parsl作为全局工作流引擎，协调LAMMPS中大规模MD和MC任务，在精细温度-成分网格上并行采样，计算液相和固相的自由能，再通过PyCalphad进行CALPHAD建模。
AI.result: 实现了大规模并行化和强可扩展性，能够高效构建多元素相图。
AI.conclusion: Exa-PD提供了一种高效、可扩展的工作流方案，适用于复杂多元素相图的自动化构建。

title: Zigzag ordering, defects, and anomalous relaxation in antiferromagnetic Kuramoto lattices
summary: We investigate the nonequilibrium ordering dynamics of coupled Kuramoto oscillators with negative nearest-neighbor coupling, which induces a zigzag antiferromagnetic ordering. In one dimension, the defect density exhibits anomalously slow coarsening, decaying as $(D(t)\sim t^{-1/4})$ before saturating at a system-size-dependent time $(t_c(N)\sim N^z)$ with (z=2). The local persistence probability follows a stretched-exponential form, $(P(t)\sim \exp(-c t^α))$, with $(α=1/4)$. These exponents are observed are independent of the magnitude of the coupling, which merely rescales the characteristic time scale. The equality $(α=δ=1/4)$ together with (z=2) is consistent with a distinct universality class. These results demonstrate that deterministic nonlinear dynamics and geometric frustration alone are sufficient to generate slow relaxation and anomalous scaling, without quenched disorder or stochastic noise. A continuum approximation and the corresponding coarse-grained partial differential equation provide a theoretical explanation for the observed anomalous exponents, while linear stability analysis accounts for the emergence of the zigzag ordered state. In two dimensions, geometric frustration inhibits complete ordering and gives rise to long-lived metastable domain-wall structures. An initial transient defect decay is observed before crossover and saturation. These results demonstrate how frustration and continuous phase variables can fundamentally modify coarsening dynamics and generate anomalously slow relaxation in deterministic many-body systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有负最近邻耦合的Kuramoto振子系统的非平衡有序化动力学，发现一维系统呈现异常缓慢的粗化过程（缺陷密度以t^{-1/4}衰减），局部持久概率呈拉伸指数形式（指数α=1/4），这些标度指数构成独特的普适类。二维系统中几何阻挫导致无法完全有序，形成长寿命亚稳态畴壁结构。
AI.motivation: 探究确定性非线性动力学与几何阻挫相结合能否在没有淬火无序或随机噪声的情况下产生缓慢松弛和反常标度行为，理解连续相位变量和阻挫如何从根本上改变粗化动力学。
AI.method: 采用负最近邻耦合的Kuramoto模型进行数值模拟，结合连续近似和粗粒化偏微分方程进行理论分析，利用线性稳定性分析解释锯齿有序态的出现。
AI.result: 一维系统中缺陷密度以t^{-1/4}衰减，饱和时间标度z=2；局部持久概率指数α=1/4；这些指数与耦合强度无关，仅时间尺度被重新标度。二维系统中阻挫抑制完全有序，出现长寿命亚稳态畴壁结构，缺陷衰减后经历交叉和饱和。
AI.conclusion: 确定性非线性动力学和几何阻挫足以产生缓慢松弛和反常标度，形成独特的普适类（α=δ=1/4, z=2），无需随机噪声或淬火无序。该研究揭示了阻挫与连续相位变量如何根本性地改变多体系统的粗化动力学。

title: Long range spatial correlations in the periodically driven transverse field Ising model
summary: We consider a periodically driven transverse field Ising model and study the long-time behavior of the correlations between the excitations in the spin chain. We show that the longest correlation length is defined by the interference between the topological defects induced by the analog of the Kibble-Zurek mechanism and those induced by the Floquet resonance. We show that although the correlations always have a finite correlation length since the system is integrable, the correlation length can be made arbitrarily large by tuning the drive period.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了周期驱动横场Ising模型中激发之间关联的长期行为，发现最大关联长度由Kibble-Zurek机制与Floquet共振诱导的拓扑缺陷之间的干涉决定。尽管系统是可积的，关联长度有限，但通过调节驱动周期可使其任意增大。
AI.motivation: 探究周期驱动量子系统中激发关联的长期行为，揭示驱动参数对关联长度的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用周期驱动的横场Ising模型，分析激发之间关联的长期演化，通过对比Kibble-Zurek机制和Floquet共振诱导的拓扑缺陷干涉来刻画关联长度。
AI.result: 发现关联长度由两种拓扑缺陷干涉决定，虽系统可积导致关联长度有限，但通过调节驱动周期可使其任意增大。
AI.conclusion: 在可积周期驱动系统中，关联长度可通过驱动参数灵活调控，为控制量子关联提供新途径。

title: Thermal Order by Disorder in Resonating-Valence Bond States on the Checkerboard Lattice
comment: 10 pages, including 6 pages of Supplementary Materials
summary: We derive a local spin-1/2 Hamiltonian with a resonating valence bond ground state on the checkerboard lattice. The state is characterized by the exponential decay of singlet-singlet correlations, whereas dimer-dimer correlations decay with a power law in the corresponding Quantum Dimer model. This observation leads to a novel mechanism for thermal Order by Disorder whereby thermal decoherence suppresses destructive quantum interference between different contributions to the correlations in the ground state and results in a qualitatively different, quasi-long-range ordered mixed state.

AI.tldr: 本文在棋盘格子上推导出了具有共振价键基态的局域自旋-1/2哈密顿量，发现单态-单态关联指数衰减，而二聚体-二聚体关联在量子二聚体模型中呈幂律衰减。由此提出了一种新的热致有序机制：热退相干抑制了基态关联中不同贡献之间的破坏性量子干涉，导致一种性质不同的准长程有序混合态。
AI.motivation: 探索棋盘格子上共振价键态的特性，特别是量子干涉效应对关联函数的影响，以及热效应对量子有序的调控机制。
AI.method: 推导局域自旋-1/2哈密顿量，构建共振价键基态，分析单态-单态和二聚体-二聚体关联函数，结合量子二聚体模型研究热序机制。
AI.result: 单态-单态关联呈指数衰减，二聚体-二聚体关联呈幂律衰减；热退相干能抑制破坏性量子干涉，产生准长程有序的混合态。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种新的热致有序（Order by Disorder）机制，揭示了热效应可以通过抑制量子干涉来改变关联性质，为理解量子磁性系统中的热行为提供了新视角。

title: Fermion parity of an Andreev molecule probed by nonlocal Josephson effect
summary: Fermion parity is a fundamental property of superconducting many-body states. Here, we show that the global fermion parity of a delocalized superconducting state can be detected locally by exploiting the nonlocal Josephson effect. Using a carbon nanotube-based Andreev molecule formed by two coupled quantum-dot Josephson junctions, we observe a pronounced nonlocal Josephson response and demonstrate the formation of delocalized Andreev molecular states extending across both junctions. We further show that changes in the molecular ground-state parity manifest as characteristic $π$-phase shifts in the nonlocal response. Supported by a minimal theoretical model, these results identify global fermion parity as an experimentally accessible degree of freedom in hybrid superconducting circuits that can be readily revealed through the nonlocal Josephson effect.

AI.tldr: 本文通过碳纳米管基的安德烈夫分子实验，展示了非局域约瑟夫森效应可探测超导态的整体费米子宇称，并通过π相位位移反映分子基态宇称变化。
AI.motivation: 探索如何利用非局域约瑟夫森效应在局域尺度上探测离域超导态的整体费米子宇称这一基本性质。
AI.method: 构建碳纳米管基的安德烈夫分子（两个耦合量子点约瑟夫森结），观测非局域约瑟夫森响应，并结合最小理论模型分析。
AI.result: 观察到显著的的非局域约瑟夫森响应，证明形成了跨越两个结的离域安德烈夫分子态；发现分子基态宇称变化表现为非局域响应中的特征π相位位移。
AI.conclusion: 全局费米子宇称可作为混合超导电路中的可实验访问自由度，通过非局域约瑟夫森效应即可揭示。

title: Nonequilibrium thermodynamics of feedback-control: a phase-space perspective
summary: Maxwell demons can convert knowledge into thermodynamic advantage by using measurement-acquired information. However, standard formulations of this problem assume that the demon has access to the system's entire phase space, an assumption that fails in many practical applications. Here, I address this problem by deriving fluctuation relations for general feedback-controlled systems, including such singular cases. The central quantity is a generalized notion of unavailable information: a portion of the acquired information that cannot be used to extract useful work. Finally, a Szilard engine with finite resolution illustrates these results. In the high-resolution limit, the information acquired by the demon may diverge, yet the extractable work remains finite. This work shows that this occurs because an equally divergent amount of information becomes unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了通用反馈控制系统的涨落关系，引入了“不可用信息”的概念，解释了为什么在有限分辨率Szilard引擎中，即使获取的信息发散，可提取功仍有限。
AI.motivation: 标准麦克斯韦妖模型假设恶魔能访问系统整个相空间，这在实际应用中往往不成立。本文旨在解决反馈控制系统在非理想测量条件下的信息-功转换问题。
AI.method: 推导了包含奇异情况在内的通用反馈控制系统的涨落关系，引入了广义的“不可用信息”概念，并通过有限分辨率的Szilard引擎进行实例验证。
AI.result: 在高分辨率极限下，恶魔获取的信息量可能发散，但可提取功保持有限；这是因为同样发散的“不可用信息”抵消了信息增益。
AI.conclusion: 信息获取并不等同于功提取能力，不可用信息的概念解释了实际系统中信息-功转换的根本限制，为有限测量精度下的热力学信息处理提供了理论框架。

title: Strong intervalley mixing between copropagating quantum Hall edge channels in a silicon MOSFET
summary: Copropagating quantum Hall edge channels provide a promising platform for compact electron interferometry and flying quantum states. In silicon, the valley degree of freedom offers a natural alternative to spin-resolved edge channels because spin-flip scattering is strongly suppressed by the weak spin-orbit interaction. Here, we investigate interchannel transitions between copropagating valley edge channels in a double-layer-gated silicon metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor. With the bulk filling factor set to $ν=2$, two spin-polarized valley edge channels are brought into close proximity near a depleted side gate. We observe strong intervalley mixing, with a transition probability close to 1/2, indicating nearly complete equilibration between the two valley edge channels. In contrast, interchannel transport between edge channels with different spin orientations shows negligible transition probability, consistent with suppressed spin-flip scattering in silicon. These results demonstrate that intervalley coupling at a Si/SiO$_2$ interface can provide a beam-splitter-like operation for copropagating valley edge channels, establishing a key building block toward compact silicon quantum Hall interferometers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究硅基双栅MOSFET中谷量子霍尔边缘通道间的跃迁，发现靠近耗尽侧栅时，两个自旋极化的谷边缘通道发生强区间混合，跃迁概率接近1/2，表明近乎完全平衡；而不同自旋方向的通道间跃迁概率可忽略。这展示了Si/SiO₂界面谷耦合可实现类似分束器的功能，为紧凑型硅量子霍尔干涉仪奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 量子霍尔边缘通道是紧凑型电子干涉仪和飞行量子态的重要平台。硅材料中谷自由度可作为自旋分辨边缘通道的天然替代，因为自旋翻转散射被弱自旋轨道耦合强烈抑制。然而，谷边缘通道间的可控耦合尚未被充分研究，而这正是实现干涉仪的关键。
AI.method: 采用双栅硅MOSFET器件，体填充因子设为ν=2，使两个自旋极化的谷边缘通道在耗尽侧栅附近紧密靠近。通过测量通道间的跃迁概率来表征谷间混合强度。
AI.result: 观察到强烈的谷间混合，跃迁概率接近1/2，表明近乎完全的谷平衡；而不同自旋方向的边缘通道间跃迁概率可忽略，与硅中自旋翻转散射被压制的预期一致。
AI.conclusion: Si/SiO₂界面的谷耦合可实现类似分束器的操作，为构建紧凑型硅量子霍尔干涉仪提供了关键基础组件。

title: Exploring the Potential of BY3 (Y = P, As) Monolayers as High-Capacity and Rapid-Diffusion Anodes for Sodium-Ion Batteries
summary: The rapid advancement of sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) demands robust anode materials capable of delivering high specific capacities while maintaining rapid ion transport kinetics. In this work, we employ first-principles density functional theory (DFT) to systematically evaluate the two-dimensional BX3 (X = As, P) monolayers as high-performance anode candidates for SIBs. Our calculations reveal that both the BAs3 and BP3 frameworks exhibit excellent mechanical and dynamical stability alongside an intrinsic metallic character. These materials demonstrate a strong thermodynamic affinity for Na adsorption, driven by a synergistic ionic and covalent bonding mechanism that highly favors the H3 hollow site. Furthermore, they facilitate exceptionally fast charge and discharge kinetics, characterized by ultralow optimal Na-ion migration barriers of 0.19 eV and 0.26 eV for BAs3 and BP3, respectively. Crucially, projected density of states (PDOS) analyses confirm that both systems preserve their robust metallic conductivity even at their maximum theoretical sodiation limits (Na120B8X24), ensuring continuous and efficient electron transport throughout the electrochemical cycle. We predict low, stable average open-circuit voltages of 0.15 V for BAs3 and 0.18 V for BP3, alongside ultrahigh theoretical specific capacities of 1365 mAh g-1 and 3875 mAh g-1, respectively, which significantly outperform contemporary 2D SIB anodes. These compelling theoretical findings establish the BX3 monolayers as outstanding, structurally resilient candidates for next-generation, high-energy-density energy storage systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理DFT计算，系统评估了BX₃ (X=As, P)二维单层材料作为钠离子电池负极的性能，发现其具有优异的机械/动力学稳定性、金属导电性、超低Na离子迁移势垒(0.19-0.26 eV)、高理论比容量(1365-3875 mAh g⁻¹)和低平均开路电压(0.15-0.18 V)，性能远超现有二维SIB负极材料。
AI.motivation: 钠离子电池发展亟需兼具高比容量和快速离子传输动力学的高性能负极材料，现有二维负极材料性能有限，因此需要探索新型二维材料作为候选。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论(DFT)进行计算，系统评估BAs₃和BP₃单层的稳定性、电子结构、Na吸附特性、离子迁移势垒、开路电压和理论比容量等关键性能指标。
AI.result: BAs₃和BP₃单层均表现出优异的机械/动力学稳定性、固有金属特性、强Na吸附亲和力(优先H3位点)、超低迁移势垒(0.19 eV和0.26 eV)、即使在最大钠化极限下仍保持金属导电性、低开路电压(0.15 V和0.18 V)以及超高理论比容量(1365和3875 mAh g⁻¹)。
AI.conclusion: BX₃二维单层材料是极具前景的下一代高能量密度钠离子电池负极候选材料，具有出色的结构稳定性和电化学性能，显著优于现有二维SIB负极材料。

title: Altermagnetism without a long-range order
summary: The Kugel-Khomskii spin-pseudospin model, originally developed for transition-metal compounds with orbital degrees of freedom, has recently been reinterpreted in the context of altermagnetism. In this work, we theoretically investigate the emergence of altermagnetic behavior in the absence of long-range magnetic or orbital order. Using the rotation-invariant Green's function method for the SU(2) x SU(2) symmetric model on a square lattice and on a linear chain, we analyze spin-spin and spin-pseudospin correlation functions, excitation spectra, heat capacity, and susceptibilities. We show that beyond a critical intersubsystem exchange Kc(T), a composite state arises with nonzero spin-pseudospin correlations, even though the average spin and pseudospin at each site are zero. The excitation spectrum splits into acoustic and optical branches, with nodal lines along qx = qy - a direct signature of altermagnetic symmetry. A peak in heat capacity and a jump in susceptibility are observed at the phase boundary. In 1D, the phase boundary is nonmonotonic and demonstrates reentrant transition. These results establish the concept of an "altermagnetic paramagnet" or "altermagnetic liquid" without long-range order, relevant for low-dimensional and strongly fluctuating systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过旋转不变的格林函数方法，在无长程磁序或轨道序的条件下，证明了Kugel-Khomskii模型中可出现具有节点线的交变磁（altermagnetic）关联态，提出了"交变磁顺磁体"或"交变磁液体"的概念。
AI.motivation: 将原本用于过渡金属化合物轨道自由度的Kugel-Khomskii自旋-赝自旋模型重新诠释于交变磁背景，探究在缺乏长程磁性或轨道有序的情况下，交变磁行为能否涌现。
AI.method: 采用SU(2) × SU(2)对称模型的旋转不变格林函数方法，在正方晶格和一维链上分析自旋-自旋及自旋-赝自旋关联函数、激发谱、热容和磁化率。
AI.result: 超过临界交换作用Kc(T)时出现非零自旋-赝自旋关联的复合态；激发谱分裂为声学支和光学支，在qx= qy方向出现节线；热容出现峰值，磁化率出现跳跃；一维中相边界非单调，呈现重返相变。
AI.conclusion: 建立了无长程有序的"交变磁顺磁体"或"交变磁液体"概念，为低维和强涨落系统中的交变磁行为提供了理论基础。

title: Drift-Induced Nonreciprocal Hyperbolic Polaritons in Graphene/$α$-MoO$_3$ Heterostructures
summary: Achieving optical isolation requires breaking symmetry between forward- and backward-propagating light, a long-standing challenge at the nanoscale in the absence of magnetic fields. Here we theoretically demonstrate electrically tunable nonreciprocal phonon-plasmon polaritons in a graphene/$α$-MoO$_3$/SiC heterostructure operating in the mid-infrared. A dc current in graphene induces a wavevector-dependent Doppler shift that breaks reciprocity and generates strong directional asymmetry in hybrid plasmon-phonon propagation. In the reciprocal regime, hybridization between graphene plasmons and hyperbolic phonon polaritons in $α$-MoO$_3$, further shaped by the SiC substrate, enables gate-controlled transitions of isofrequency contours, including canalization along orthogonal crystal axes. At drift velocities of 5% of the Fermi velocity, the system exhibits pronounced momentum-dependent nonreciprocity with contrast reaching $\sim$ 0.3, while directions orthogonal to the drift remain unaffected due to symmetry imposed constraints. Real-space calculations confirm that this momentum-space asymmetry translates into directional near-field intensity modulation. These results establish current-biased van der Waals heterostructures as a platform for electrically tunable, magnet-free nonreciprocal nanophotonics in the mid-infrared.

AI.tldr: 本文在理论上演示了石墨烯/α-MoO₃/SiC异质结构中电可调的非互易声子-等离子体激元，通过石墨烯中的直流电流引入多普勒频移打破互易性，实现了中红外波段无磁场的非互易纳米光子学。
AI.motivation: 在纳米尺度上实现无磁场的光隔离是一个长期挑战，现有的非互易方案大多依赖磁光效应，难以集成。本文旨在提出一种无需外加磁场、电可调的非互易纳米光子学方案。
AI.method: 构建石墨烯/α-MoO₃/SiC异质结构，利用石墨烯中直流电流引起的波矢依赖多普勒频移打破互易性；通过石墨烯等离激元与α-MoO₃双曲声子极化激元的杂化，结合SiC衬底调控等频轮廓。
AI.result: 当漂移速度达到费米速度的5%时，系统表现出显著的非互易性，对比度可达~0.3；正交于漂移方向的光传播不受影响；实空间计算证实动量空间不对称性转化为方向性近场强度调制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了电流偏置的范德华异质结构作为中红外波段电可调、无磁场的非互易纳米光子学平台。

title: Symbolic Predicate-Guided Language Agents for Inverse Design of Perovskite Oxides
summary: Efficient discovery of high-performance materials has been pursued through a variety of data- and AI-driven strategies, among which inverse design, generating materials from desired target properties, has emerged as an important paradigm. Large language models (LLMs) offer a complementary route for inverse materials design because their reasoning and in-context learning capability can be used not only to propose candidates but also to demonstrate interpretable design principles. In this work, we introduce a domain specific language (DSL)-guided strategy to improve the reasoning and design capability of LLM agents by translating natural language design rules into symbolic predicates encoded in a predefined chemistry DSL. These predicates allow the LLM agent to obtain statistical evidence from the accumulated materials data, enabling the agent to evaluate and refine its own reasoning during the design loop. Based on this strategy, we developed a multi-agent materials design framework, called Operational Rule-grounded CHEmical Search Through Reasoning Agents (ORCHESTRA), and applied it to the inverse design of double perovskite oxides under multiple target-property objectives. The results show that symbolic predicates help the LLM identify unsupported rules, validate newly proposed rules and improve the rule store over iterative design cycles. Compared with a strategy relying only on natural language rules, the DSL-guided framework showed the potential to improve materials design performance, particularly for challenging target properties. These findings suggest that mathematical and statistical grounding can enhance the reasoning capability of LLM agents in materials science and that LLM-based inverse design can be performed effectively without large task-specific datasets or additional model training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种领域特定语言(DSL)引导的策略来增强LLM代理在材料逆设计中的推理能力，开发了ORCHESTRA多代理框架，通过符号谓词将自然语言设计规则转化为可统计验证的形式，在双钙钛矿氧化物的多目标逆设计中展现出优于纯自然语言规则策略的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统材料逆设计方法依赖大量数据和预训练模型，而LLM虽然具备推理能力，但在材料科学领域缺乏严格的形式化验证机制。作者希望利用DSL将模糊的自然语言设计规则转化为可统计验证的符号谓词，让LLM代理能够基于累积数据自我评估和修正推理，从而提高材料设计的可靠性和性能。
AI.method: 提出ORCHESTRA多代理框架：1) 定义化学领域的DSL，将自然语言设计规则编码为符号谓词；2) LLM代理利用这些谓词从累积材料数据中获取统计证据；3) 代理在设计循环中持续评估、验证和优化规则库；4) 应用于双钙钛矿氧化物的多目标逆设计任务。
AI.result: 符号谓词帮助LLM识别不合理的规则、验证新提出的规则，并在迭代过程中改善规则库。与纯自然语言规则策略相比，DSL引导的框架在提升材料设计性能方面表现出潜力，尤其是在处理具有挑战性的目标属性时更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 数学和统计基础能够增强LLM代理在材料科学中的推理能力；基于LLM的逆设计可以在无需大规模任务特定数据集或额外模型训练的情况下有效进行。DSL引导的符号化策略为提升AI驱动材料设计的可解释性和可靠性提供了新路径。

title: Deconfined quantum critical point in a dissipative spin-1/2 chain
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Supplemental materials: 15 pages, 11 figures
summary: Open quantum spin systems offer a previously unexplored route to realizing deconfined quantum criticality. We consider a spin-1/2 $J$-$Q_3$ chain, consisting of an antiferromagnetic (AFM) Heisenberg exchange and a competing multi-spin interaction favoring a valence-bond solid (VBS) state, with each spin component coupled to a bosonic bath. Using non-Abelian bosonization and renormalization-group (RG) analysis, combined with large-scale quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations, we determine the phase diagram and the associated phase transitions of the model. We show that strong dissipation stabilizes an AFM phase for sub-Ohmic, Ohmic, and super-Ohmic baths. Continuous AFM-VBS transitions at finite dissipation are found upon increasing the multi-spin interaction in both the sub-Ohmic and Ohmic regimes. Critical properties are obtained through perturbative RG analysis and QMC simulations. In the Ohmic case, the critical point features spinon deconfinement and emergent O(4) symmetry. In the sub-Ohmic regime, the transition may also involve spinon deconfinement, provided that spinons remain deconfined in the dissipative VBS phase. In addition, in the super-Ohmic regime, we propose a transition from AFM phase to a quasi-long-range ordered phase.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自旋-1/2 J-Q3链（反铁磁海森堡交换与多自旋相互作用竞争）耦合玻色子浴的开放量子自旋系统。通过非阿贝尔玻色化、重正化群分析和量子蒙特卡洛模拟，发现强耗散稳定了反铁磁相，在亚欧姆和欧姆区观察到连续的反铁磁-价键固体相变，其中欧姆临界点具有自旋子退禁闭和涌现O(4)对称性。
AI.motivation: 探索开放量子自旋系统作为实现退禁闭量子临界性的新途径，研究耗散对量子相变的影响。
AI.method: 结合非阿贝尔玻色化、重正化群分析和大规模量子蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.result: 强耗散稳定了反铁磁相；在亚欧姆和欧姆区发现连续相变；欧姆临界点有自旋子退禁闭和O(4)对称性；超欧姆区提出反铁磁到准长程序相的转变。
AI.conclusion: 耗散可以作为一种调控手段实现退禁闭量子临界性，为研究开放量子系统中的新奇量子相变提供了新的理论框架。

title: Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy as a Universal Defect Fingerprinting Tool for Organic Halide Perovskite Solar Cells
comment: New viewpoint for the defect detection using THz-wave absorption property in halide perovksite materials
summary: Organic-inorganic hybrid perovskites (OHPs) deliver certified single-junction power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) exceeding 26% and perovskite-silicon tandem values surpassing 34%, yet a substantial gap with the Shockley-Queisser (S-Q) limit persists-primarily due to grain-boundary (GB) defects that drive non-radiative recombination, ion migration, and degradation. Rational passivation demands a non-contact tool capable of identifying and quantifying specific defect species in device-relevant thin films, a capability absent from conventional probes. This short review demonstrates that terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS, 0.3-3.0 THz) fulfills this role. Across four OHP compositions fabricated by sequential vacuum evaporation (SVE)-MAPbI3, MAPbBr3, FAPbI3, and CsPbI3-the THz spectral window captures both intrinsic phonon modes and GB-localized molecular defect vibrations, enabling species-specific, quantitative characterization at room temperature. Notably, the oscillator strength of the SVE-specific 1.58 THz absorption in MAPbI3 scales linearly with XPS-quantified CH3NH2 defect concentration, establishing THz-TDS as a direct, non-destructive defect meter. Building on these findings, we propose a three-pillar framework for THz-guided defect engineering: (I) quantitative defect measurement via oscillator-strength analysis, (II) material-specific fingerprint identification from a systematically constructed THz library, and (III) fingerprint-guided defect elimination with real-time feedback-together defining a closed-loop quality-control cycle that connects spectroscopic diagnosis to passivation strategy and, ultimately, to enhanced solar-cell efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）作为一种非接触、非破坏性工具，能够定量识别和表征有机-无机杂化钙钛矿（OHP）薄膜中的晶界缺陷种类，并提出基于THz指纹的三支柱缺陷工程框架，以缩小钙钛矿太阳能电池与Shockley-Queisser极限之间的效率差距。
AI.motivation: 钙钛矿太阳能电池效率虽已突破26%（单结）和34%（硅基叠层），但因晶界缺陷导致非辐射复合、离子迁移和降解，与理论极限仍存在显著差距。现有表征手段无法对器件级薄膜中的具体缺陷种类进行非接触式定量识别与测量，亟需一种新的表征工具。
AI.method: 采用太赫兹时域光谱（0.3-3.0 THz）对四种通过顺序真空蒸发（SVE）制备的钙钛矿组分（MAPbI3, MAPbBr3, FAPbI3, CsPbI3）进行测量，捕获本征声子模式与晶界局域分子缺陷振动，并通过振子强度与XPS定量缺陷浓度的线性关系验证其定量能力。
AI.result: THz-TDS在室温下即可实现缺陷种类的特异性识别和定量表征；MAPbI3中1.58 THz吸收峰的振子强度与XPS定量的CH3NH2缺陷浓度呈线性关系，确立了THz-TDS作为直接、非破坏性缺陷测量工具的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出THz引导缺陷工程的三支柱框架：（I）基于振子强度的定量缺陷测量，（II）基于THz光谱库的材料特异性指纹识别，（III）指纹引导的缺陷消除与实时反馈，形成从光谱诊断到钝化策略再到效率提升的闭环质量控制循环。

title: Quantum Fisher information of magnetic quantum phase transition on Kondo lattice
summary: Strange metals exemplify highly collective quantum many-body systems that call for new means of characterization, and there is considerable potential for quantum information approaches contributing to the cause. We investigate multipartite entanglement across the quantum phase transition of a Kondo lattice model using the quantum Fisher information (QFI). We show that the QFI associated with the spin components transverse to the order parameter characterizes the destruction of heavy quasiparticles in the Kondo-destroyed magnetic-ordered phase. The physical origin of this observation is elucidated through an analysis of the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model. We propose to test the results in terms of both unpolarized and polarized inelastic neutron scattering measurements in the ordered part of the heavy fermion phase diagram. Our findings illustrate how different operators of a many-body system can be employed to not only witness multipartite entanglement in different sectors and but also elucidate the overall physics across different parts of the phase diagram.

AI.tldr: 本文利用量子Fisher信息（QFI）研究Kondo晶格模型量子相变中的多体纠缠，发现横向自旋QFI可表征重准粒子在Kondo破坏磁有序相中的毁灭，并通过反铁磁海森堡模型阐明其物理起源，提出用非极化与极化非弹性中子散射进行实验验证。
AI.motivation: 奇异金属等强关联量子多体系统需要新的表征手段，量子信息方法有潜力为此做出贡献。
AI.method: 利用量子Fisher信息（QFI）分析Kondo晶格模型的量子相变，并结合反铁磁海森堡模型进行物理机制阐释。
AI.result: 横向于序参量的自旋QFI可以表征Kondo破坏磁有序相中重准粒子的毁灭。
AI.conclusion: 不同多体算符可用于见证不同扇区中的多体纠缠，并阐明相图中不同部分的整体物理。

title: Electrothermal control of spin-reorientation transition in Co/Fe_3GaTe_2 heterostructures
summary: Electrical control of magnetic anisotropy in van der Waals (vdWs) magnets is a key step toward reconfigurable two-dimensional spintronics, yet how a conventional metallic ferromagnet competes with a van der Waals magnet across a direct interface has remained largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate reversible thermal and electrothermal control of a spin-reorientation transition in Co/Fe_3GaTe_2 (FGaT) heterostructures. As Joule heating weakens the FGaT anisotropy, the heterostructure switches from an out-of-plane- to an in-plane-dominated state at a reorientation temperature of approximately 311 K, well below the Curie temperature, consistent with an exchange-mediated anisotropy competition between the Co overlayer and FGaT. An electrically driven device shows a closely matching loop evolution within an 80-100 mW power window, reversibly over five measurement cycles, consistent with an electrothermal origin. In a Co-free FGaT device, Kerr microscopy traces the switching to a power-tunable domain nucleation barrier and demonstrates power-thresholded, field-assisted magnetization reversal at a threshold near 15 mW. These results demonstrate electrothermal anisotropy competition as a route to heat-assisted and device-level control of vdWs magnetism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Co/Fe₃GaTe₂异质结中通过热和电热控制的自旋重取向转变，实现了vdW磁体的可逆磁各向异性调控，为二维自旋电子学提供了新路径。
AI.motivation: 传统金属铁磁体与vdW磁体在直接界面处的各向异性竞争机制尚未被探索，而电控vdW磁体的磁各向异性是实现可重构二维自旋电子学的关键。
AI.method: 构建Co/Fe₃GaTe₂异质结，通过焦耳热效应调控FGaT磁各向异性，利用Kerr显微术和电输运测量研究自旋重取向转变及磁畴反转行为。
AI.result: 观察到约311 K的spin-reorientation转变温度；电驱动器件在80-100 mW功率窗口内实现可逆循环；Co-free器件中观察到功率阈值约15 mW的场辅助磁化反转。
AI.conclusion: 电热各向异性竞争可作为热辅助和器件级控制vdW磁性的有效途径，为低功耗自旋电子器件设计提供新思路。

title: Symmetry-Enforced Dirac Fermions and Structural Metastability in Pentagonal Monolayers of Transition-Metal Ditellurides
summary: The recent synthesis of pentagonal PdTe$_2$ monolayer motivates broader research interests in transition-metal ditellurides whose electronic phases are governed by symmetry and structural reconstruction. The pentagonal phase of transition-metal ditellurides exhibits electronic properties that are dramatically different from those of its hexagonal counterpart due to its lower crystalline symmetry. Using first-principles calculations, we study monolayer $X$Te$_2$ ($X=\mathrm{Pd},\mathrm{Pt},\mathrm{Ni}$) in both hexagonal and pentagonal polymorphs. By constructing a continuous structural interpolation between the hexagonal and pentagonal phases, we show that the semimetal (hex)-to-semiconductor (penta) transition occurs only after an intermediate structural threshold rather than at the onset of symmetry reduction. The gap opening coincides with the formation of Te--Te dimers, which drive the bonding--antibonding splitting of the Te $p$ states and reorganize the band edges. In addition, the nonsymmorphic symmetry of the pentagonal phase enforces band degeneracies at the Brillouin-zone boundary, leading to symmetry-protected two-dimensional (2D) Dirac states. These results establish pentagonal $X$Te$_2$ monolayers as a new class of 2D semiconductors in which symmetry constraints and local bonding collectively shape the unconventional semiconducting electronic structure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，系统研究了PdTe₂、PtTe₂、NiTe₂单层在六方和五方两种多型相中的电子结构，发现六方到五方的半金属-半导体转变并非随对称性降低立即发生，而是需要越过一个结构阈值，且能隙打开与Te-Te二聚体形成密切相关，五方相中的非点式对称性还在布里渊区边界产生了对称保护的二维狄拉克态。
AI.motivation: 五边形PdTe₂单层的实验合成启发研究者关注过渡金属二碲化物中对称性与结构重构对电子相的调控作用，旨在揭示五方相如何通过低对称性产生与六方相截然不同的电子性质。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理（密度泛函理论）计算，研究PdTe₂、PtTe₂、NiTe₂单层在六方和五方两种多型相中的电子结构；构建六方到五方之间的连续结构插值路径，分析转变过程中的电子结构演化。
AI.result: 六方到五方的半金属-半导体转变并非在对称性降低时立即发生，而是需要越过一个中间结构阈值；能隙打开与Te-Te二聚体形成同步，驱动Te p态的成键-反键分裂并重组能带边缘；五方相的非点式对称性在布里渊区边界产生对称保护的二维狄拉克态。
AI.conclusion: 五方XTe₂单层是一类新型二维半导体，其非常规的半导体电子结构由对称性约束和局域成键共同塑造，为二维半导体材料设计提供了新思路。

title: Photoelectrical readout and Ramsey interferometry of single shallowly implanted NV centers in diamond
summary: Photoelectrical readout of the electronic spin state of the nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center in diamond is attracting significant interest due to the numerous advantages it possesses compared with conventional fluorescence readout. The higher charge carrier rate compared to the photon rate and the integration of the detection scheme on a chip can significantly advance quantum sensing and computing with color centers in diamond. Until now, photoelectric readout has been performed on ensembles of NV centers or single NV centers deep in ultrapure diamond substrates. However, many applications require the artificial creation and precise placement of shallow NV centers, and photoelectric detection of such centers has been challenging. Here we demonstrate photoelectrical readout and coherent control of the electronic spin of implanted shallow ($\sim$10 nm) NV centers buried by diamond overgrowth. The photoelectrically measured Ramsey $T_2^*$ agrees with conventional fluorescence readout and shows no measurable dependence on the readout photocurrent, for both shallow implanted and deep ingrown NV centers. We further find that overgrowth improves photoelectric readout by suppressing the background photocurrent. These results establish photoelectric readout as a viable route to chip-integrated, electrically detected nanoscale sensing and to spin registers based on engineered shallow NV centers.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了在浅层（~10 nm）注入并经金刚石外延过生长的NV中心上实现光电读出和相干控制，证明光电读出可作为芯片集成纳米传感和自旋寄存器的一种可行途径。
AI.motivation: 尽管光电读出相比荧光读出具有更高的载流子速率和芯片集成优势，但此前仅能在体块金刚石中的深NV中心或NV ensembles上实现，浅层NV中心的光电检测一直具有挑战性，而许多应用正需要人工创建精准放置的浅层NV中心。
AI.method: 通过在浅层注入（~10 nm）NV中心上进行金刚石过生长，实现光电读出和相干控制，并与传统荧光读出进行对比验证，同时研究过生长对背景光电流的抑制效果。
AI.result: 光电测量的Ramsey T₂*与传统荧光读出一致，且对读出光电流无显著依赖性；过生长可有效抑制背景光电流，改善光电读出性能。
AI.conclusion: 光电读出是实现芯片集成、电学检测的纳米传感以及基于工程化浅层NV中心的自旋寄存器的可行途径。

title: General and scalable vapor etching and transformation platform for two-dimensional materials
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) nanomaterials derived from non-van der Waals (non-vdW) solids offer exceptional physicochemical properties, yet their synthesis is impeded by intrinsic covalent/metallic bonding and high surface reactivity of the precursors. Here, we report a general vapor-phase etching and transformation platform for producing a library of 36 2D carbides, nitrides, and carbonitrides, exhibiting electrical conductivities spanning six orders of magnitude. Using reactive vapors like hydrogen chloride, we selectively remove A-layers from MAX phases to yield well-defined layers (MXenes), including previously inaccessible semiconducting Hf2CTx. By varying the reactive vapor environment, MXenes can be engineered at X-site and surface-termination site and even be transformed into non-vdW layers such as 2D MAX phases. This general and scalable vapor-phase platform reframes 2D material synthesis, opening new avenues for various applications.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种通用气相刻蚀与转化平台，成功合成出36种2D碳化物、氮化物和碳氮化物（包括半导体Hf₂CTₓ），其导电率跨度达六个数量级。该方法通过反应性蒸气（如HCl）选择性刻蚀MAX相中的A层，生成MXene及其他非vdW层状材料，为2D材料合成开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 非范德华（non-vdW）固体衍生的二维纳米材料具有卓越的物理化学性质，但其合成受限于前驱体固有的共价/金属键和高表面反应性，缺乏通用的合成策略。
AI.method: 采用气相刻蚀与转化平台，利用反应性蒸气（如氯化氢）选择性去除MAX相中的A层，从而获得明确层状结构的MXene。通过改变蒸气环境，可在X位和表面终止位进行工程化调控，甚至转化为2D MAX相等非vdW层状材料。
AI.result: 成功合成36种2D碳化物、氮化物和碳氮化物，包括此前难以获得的半导体Hf₂CTₓ；所得材料的导电率覆盖六个数量级，展示了广泛的电学性能可调性。
AI.conclusion: 该气相刻蚀平台具有通用性和可扩展性，重新定义了二维材料的合成范式，为多种应用（如电子器件、能源存储等）开辟了新方向。

title: Disentangling topological and anomalous Hall contributions of skyrmions using Kerr microscopy and thermal transport measurements
summary: The topological Hall effect is a valuable tool to indicate the presence of topologically protected magnetic structures. In this work, we present topological Hall effect measurements originating from topologically protected skyrmions in Ta/CoFeB/MgO single-layer thick films with a one nanometer thick magnetic layer. The simultaneous occurrence of the small topological Hall effect and the dominating anomalous Hall effect in this material system makes direct detection challenging as compared to bulk or multilayer systems. In electronic transport measurements, both effects' contributions impact electron trajectories in the same way, overlapping in the measurement signal, and require disentanglement. Magneto-optical Kerr microscopy was used to image the surface magnetization, enabling the separation of the topological Hall effect from other Hall effect contributions. These measurements reveal a topological Hall resistivity of $249(18)\,$\si{\pico\ohm\meter} for Ta/CoFeB/MgO layer stacks at room temperature.
