Magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements also allow tracking skyrmion formation during external magnetic field sweeps to confirm their occurrence when measuring the topological Hall effect. We verify this outcome by comparing the results with thermal and electrical transport measurements from which we calculate the overall topological quantity that gives rise to the topological Nernst and Hall effect, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文在Ta/CoFeB/MgO单层超薄薄膜（磁性层厚1 nm）中测量了拓扑霍尔效应，利用MOKE显微成像分离拓扑霍尔效应与反常霍尔效应的贡献，在室温下测得拓扑霍尔电阻率为249(18) pΩ·m，并通过热输运测量验证了斯格明子的存在。
AI.motivation: 在单层超薄薄膜中同时存在的拓扑霍尔效应(THE)和反常霍尔效应(AHE)在电输运测量中信号重叠，难以直接区分；相比块体或多层体系，单层薄膜中的THE信号非常微弱，需要有效方法将其从AHE中分离出来，以确认拓扑保护磁结构（斯格明子）的存在。
AI.method: 采用磁光克尔显微成像(MOKE)表征表面磁化状态，结合电输运测量（霍尔效应）和热输运测量（能斯特效应），通过成像结果辅助分离拓扑霍尔效应与反常霍尔效应的贡献，并追踪外磁场扫描过程中斯格明子的形成过程。
AI.result: 在室温下测得Ta/CoFeB/MgO层堆栈的拓扑霍尔电阻率为249(18) pΩ·m；MOKE成像成功观测到斯格明子的形成，并与电、热输运测量结果一致，验证了拓扑霍尔效应来源于拓扑保护的斯格明子。
AI.conclusion: 结合MOKE成像与输运测量可以可靠地从单层超薄薄膜中分离出拓扑霍尔效应，确认斯格明子的存在；该方法为研究超薄磁性薄膜中的拓扑磁结构提供了有效途径。

title: Interface-Engineered Giant Multistate Resistance Switching in Altermagnetic CrSb Multiferroic Tunnel Junctions
summary: Altermagnets enable spin-split transport without stray magnetic fields, yet converting their momentum-dependent spin splitting into a strong tunnel-junction response requires interface-selected tunneling channels. Here, using density functional theory combined with nonequilibrium Green's function calculations, we demonstrate giant multistate resistance switching in CrSb/$α$-In$_2$Se$_3$ altermagnetic multiferroic tunnel junctions. The response is governed not by the bulk spin splitting of CrSb alone, but by a symmetry-selected interfacial mechanism in which Cr/Sb terminations and \textit{h}-BN or graphene insertion layers determine spin-channel matching, while ferroelectric polarization reshapes the electrostatic barrier. Symmetric and asymmetric terminations reverse the correspondence between parallel/antiparallel Néel-vector configurations and high-/low-resistance states, showing that the actual alignment of interfacial Cr moments selects the dominant tunneling channels. Monolayer-In$_2$Se$_3$ junctions exhibit four nonvolatile resistance states, with tunneling magnetoresistance (TMR) and tunneling electroresistance (TER) reaching 1626\% and 2206\%, respectively, and increasing to 9576\% and 4144\% upon Fermi-level shifting. Finite-bias calculations further reveal robust spin filtering and tunable spin-polarized currents. Extending the barrier to bilayer In$_2$Se$_3$ introduces interlayer polarization coupling, enabling eight resistance states with maximum TMR and TER values of $3.77\times10^{4}\%$ and $4.18\times10^{5}\%$, respectively. These results establish interface symmetry, spin-channel matching, and ferroelectric barrier reconstruction as design principles for stray-field-free multistate spintronic tunnel devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT+NEGF计算，展示了CrSb/α-In₂Se₃交错磁多铁隧道结中巨大的多态电阻开关效应，TMR和TER分别可达3.77×10⁴%和4.18×10⁵%，并揭示了界面终止层、自旋通道匹配和铁电势垒重构的设计原理。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体（altermagnets）具有动量依赖的自旋分裂且无杂散磁场，但如何将其自旋分裂转化为强隧道结响应尚不明确，需要界面选择的隧穿通道来实现。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）结合非平衡格林函数（NEGF）方法，构建CrSb/α-In₂Se₃交错磁多铁隧道结，通过改变Cr/Sb界面终止层、插入h-BN或石墨烯层，以及调节铁电极化方向，系统研究其输运特性。
AI.result: 对称/非对称终止层可反转Néel矢量与高/低阻态的对应关系；单层In₂Se₃势垒结实现四非易失阻态，TMR达1626%，TER达2206%（费米能级移动后分别增至9576%和4144%）；双层In₂Se₃势垒结实现八阻态，最大TMR和TER分别达3.77×10⁴%和4.18×10⁵%。
AI.conclusion: 界面对称性、自旋通道匹配和铁电势垒重构是设计无杂散场多态自旋隧穿器件的关键原理，为交错磁体在自旋电子学中的应用提供了新方向。

title: Phase-controlled quasi-bound states in the continuum and thermoelectric enhancement in Majorana-quantum-dot nanostructures
summary: We investigate how the interplay between Majorana zero modes (MZMs) and bound states in the continuum (BICs) governs the electronic thermoelectric response of a crossbar-shaped quantum dot (QD) coupled to two topological-superconductor nanowires. Using the Green-function formalism, exact linear-response energy integrals, and their low-temperature Sommerfeld expansion, we analyze the spectral and thermoelectric properties of the system. We show that symmetry breaking converts BICs into quasi-BICs, allowing them to contribute to electrical and thermal transport and thereby generate a finite thermoelectric response. While unequal nanowire lengths, reflected in different intra-Majorana coupling strengths, produce only a modest enhancement of $ZT_{el}$, detuning the QD level increases $ZT_{el}$ by approximately one order of magnitude. Superconducting-phase control produces a much stronger enhancement, reaching $ZT_{el} \simeq 0.75$ through a quadratic transmission zero and a pronounced violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law. The low-temperature values $ZT^{max}_{el} \simeq 0.755$ and $\mathscr{L} /\mathscr{L}_{0} = 21/5$ are universal consequences of this quadratic antiresonance. Our results establish phase-tunable thermoelectric signatures of the Majorana-coupled interference structure and identify superconducting-phase control as an efficient means of engineering the electronic response of topological hybrid nanostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Majorana零模与连续谱束缚态在十字形量子点-拓扑超导纳米线混合体系中的相互作用，揭示了通过超导相位调控可实现ZT_el ≈ 0.75的显著热电性能提升，并发现了二次传输零点导致的Wiedemann-Franz定律违反以及普适的低温极限值ZT_el^{max} ≈ 0.755和ℒ/ℒ₀ = 21/5。
AI.motivation: 探究Majorana零模与连续谱束缚态在拓扑超导混合纳米结构中的热电响应耦合机制，寻找高效调控电子热电性能的物理手段。
AI.method: 采用Green函数形式体系、精确线性响应能量积分及其低温Sommerfeld展开，对十字形量子点耦合两根拓扑超导纳米线的系统进行谱学与热电性质分析。
AI.result: 对称性破缺将BICs转化为准BICs并参与输运；QD能级失谐可将ZT_el提升约一个数量级；超导相位调控实现ZT_el ≈ 0.75，并通过二次传输零点导致Wiedemann-Franz定律显著违反；低温极限值ZT_el^{max} ≈ 0.755和ℒ/ℒ₀ = 21/5具有普适性。
AI.conclusion: 建立了Majorana耦合干涉结构的相位可调热电响应特征，确认超导相位调控是设计拓扑混合纳米结构电子响应的有效手段。

title: Two-step growth of (In,Ga)N pseudo-substrates on GaN templates by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy
summary: (In,Ga)N layers are grown by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy on GaN templates. We introduce a two-step protocol that involves switching the growth conditions from initially N-stable to metal-stable. Reflection high-energy electron diffraction as well as scanning electron and atomic force microscopy reveal that the first step results in a rough intermediate surface with open pits, whereas the final surface is smooth. The narrow linewidth of the photoluminescence band indicates an excellent compositional homogeneity of the upper layer. Its in-plane lattice constant is determined to be $\approx$3.26 Åfrom X-ray diffraction measurements. This combination of favorable properties makes these layers attractive as pseudo-substrates for the growth of red-emitting (In,Ga)N light-emitting diodes. In particular, the approach presented here does not require any complex external processing and is, thus, scalable and economical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两步生长法，在GaN模板上通过等离子体辅助分子束外延生长(In,Ga)N层。第一步在氮稳定条件下获得粗糙表面，第二步切换至金属稳定条件获得光滑表面。最终得到的(In,Ga)N层具有优异组分均匀性和合适的晶格常数(约3.26Å)，适合作为红色发光二极管的外延衬底，且方法简单、可扩展、经济。
AI.motivation: 传统方法制备高质量(In,Ga)N层作为红光LED伪衬底存在工艺复杂、成本高的问题，亟需一种简单、可扩展且经济的生长方案。
AI.method: 采用两步生长协议：第一步在氮稳定条件下生长，得到含有开放坑洞的粗糙中间表面；第二步切换至金属稳定条件，最终获得光滑表面。
AI.result: 最终表面光滑，光致发光谱线宽窄表明上层组分均匀性优异；X射线衍射测得面内晶格常数约为3.26Å。
AI.conclusion: 该方法制备的(In,Ga)N层兼具光滑表面、优异组分均匀性和合适晶格常数的优点，适合作为红光LED的伪衬底，且无需复杂外部处理，具有可扩展性和经济性。

title: Qubit encodings in the p-orbital-valley spectrum for enhanced coherence and tunable two-qubit interaction
summary: We propose encoding a qubit in a two-level subspace spanned by the lowest $p$-orbital state in the excited valley of an anisotropic quantum dot and the excited $p$-orbital in the ground valley, which we dub the $pOv$ qubit. There is an avoided crossing between these states due to valley-orbit coupling (VOC) induced by alloy disorder, enabling complete single-qubit control using baseband electrical control of the dot anisotropy. We find that `sweet spots' exist at specific dot orientations where the instantaneous eigenstates are first-order insensitive to charge noise. Using a phenomenological two-level fluctuator (TLF) dipole noise model, we estimate an average dephasing time of $T_2^*\approx 10\,μ\text{s}$ and a quality factor of $Q\sim 10^4$. Alternatively, encoding in the $p$-orbital states in the ground valley near the isotropic dot point, we show that one can induce a similar sweet spot via an out-of-plane magnetic field. Finally, we find that two-qubit gates for the $pOv$ qubit are mediated by the quadrupole-quadrupole Coulomb interaction and can be electrically tuned from zero to $\sim 1~\text{GHz}$ by adjusting the relative orientation of the anisotropic dots, providing a novel pathway towards scalable quantum computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于量子点中p轨道与谷态编码的新型量子比特（pOv qubit），通过各向异性调控实现单量子比特操控，在特定点存在对电荷噪声一阶不敏感的“甜点”，并利用四极-四极库仑相互作用实现可调的双量子比特门，为可扩展量子计算提供了新路径。
AI.motivation: 传统自旋量子比特或电荷量子比特面临退相干时间长、对噪声敏感等问题，作者希望利用量子点中的轨道-谷耦合（VOC）构建一种对电荷噪声鲁棒、操控灵活且可扩展的新型量子比特。
AI.method: 利用各向异性量子点中最低p轨道激发谷态与基态谷中激发p轨道之间的避免交叉（由合金无序诱导的VOC引起），通过基带电控各向异性实现单量子比特操控；采用两能级涨落子偶极噪声模型估计退相干时间；利用四极-四极库仑相互作用实现双量子比特门。
AI.result: 在特定点取向存在电荷噪声一阶不敏感的“甜点”；估算平均退相干时间T2*≈10 μs，品质因子Q∼10^4；双量子比特门可通过调节量子点相对取向从0到约1 GHz连续调谐。
AI.conclusion: pOv qubit提供了一种对电荷噪声鲁棒、电控灵活且具有强可调双量子比特耦合的新型量子计算平台，有望推动可扩展量子计算的发展。

title: Nonuniform pressure helps structural superlubricity
summary: Structural superlubricity, nearly vanishing friction between two structurally incommensurate crystalline surfaces, is a promising avenue for reducing friction in applications, but requires very specific and well-controlled conditions. One of those conditions is perfectly uniform atomically flat surfaces. Real-world surfaces are generally rough, leading to nonuniform pressure distributions. We investigate the effects of nonuniform pressure distributions on structural superlubricity, using analytical calculations for rigid contacts as a basis, and molecular-dynamics simulations for a simple model to include the crucial effects of elasticity. We show that a key ingredient is the vanishing pressure at the edge of the contact, and that this leads to improved scaling depinning and scaling behaviour, leading to lower friction. We thus show that nonuniform pressure distributions actually help structural superlubricity, rather than hinder it.

AI.tldr: 研究发现非均匀压力分布实际上有利于结构超润滑，因为接触边缘压力为零可改善脱钉和缩放行为，降低摩擦。这挑战了传统认知——即粗糙表面会阻碍结构超润滑。
AI.motivation: 实际表面通常粗糙，导致压力分布不均匀，而结构超润滑要求完美均匀的原子级平整表面。作者想探究非均匀压力分布对结构超润滑的影响是否如直觉所认为的那样有害。
AI.method: 采用刚性接触的解析计算作为基础，结合简单模型的分子动力学模拟，纳入弹性效应的影响。
AI.result: 接触边缘压力为零是关键因素，它改善了脱钉和缩放行为，从而降低摩擦。非均匀压力分布实际上有助于结构超润滑。
AI.conclusion: 非均匀压力分布不仅不阻碍结构超润滑，反而通过边缘压力为零的效应有利于实现更低的摩擦。

title: Negative quantum friction in nanoscale water flows: the Wigner picture
summary: We explore the phenomenon of "quantum" friction based on a single-particle model patterned after the Wigner equation describing electrons flow in a solid wall confining nanoscale water flows. The numerical simulations show a clear signature of negative quantum friction, namely a net momentum transfer from the electrons in the solid wall to the flowing water molecules. Such net momentum transfer results into a sizeable reduction of the water friction, up to forty percent, depending on the strength of the coupling between classical and quantum fluctuations. Our results offer the prospect of a theoretical framework bridging classical and quantum description by using continuum kinetic theories and particle-based simulations.

AI.tldr: 基于单粒子Wigner方程模型，研究固体壁中电子对纳米尺度水流产生的“量子”摩擦现象。数值模拟显示存在负量子摩擦，即电子向水分子传递净动量，使水摩擦降低高达40%。为连接经典与量子描述提供了理论框架。
AI.motivation: 探索纳米尺度水流中固体壁电子与流体分子之间的量子摩擦现象，特别是负量子摩擦的存在及其对水摩擦的降低效应。
AI.method: 基于Wigner方程的单粒子模型进行数值模拟，耦合经典与量子涨落。
AI.result: 观察到负量子摩擦的清晰信号——电子向水分子传递净动量，使水摩擦降低高达40%。
AI.conclusion: 为连接经典与量子描述提供了理论框架，可通过连续动理学理论和基于粒子的模拟实现。

title: Structural Relaxation Enables Millisecond Infrared Photodetection in Selenium Iodine Semiconductors
comment: The main manuscript and the Supplementary Information have been merged into a single PDF file and uploaded
summary: The optoelectronic performance of amorphous and partially crystalline semiconductors is strongly governed by structural disorder, yet establishing direct correlations between structural evolution and carrier transport remains challenging. Here, we show that the solid state optoelectronic response of selenium iodine (SeI2) is dictated by its transformation from a metastable glassy phase into an ordered lamellar structure. Vertically resolved transport measurements reveal pronounced depth-dependent electrical conductivity within thick SeI2 films, arising from compositional and structural inhomogeneity developed during solidification. Immediately after solidification, the glassy SeI2 network exhibits sluggish carrier transport and persistent photoconductivity. Upon prolonged structural relaxation, however, the material undergoes significant transport enhancement, enabling millisecond-scale infrared photodetection with a response time of 4.3 ms, stable operation up to 8 kHz modulation frequency, and shot-noise-limited detectivities of 108 Jones at 1550 nm and 1011 Jones in the visible. Spatial photocurrent mapping demonstrates highly uniform carrier collection despite the self-assembled lamellar morphology, while infrared thermal imaging confirms practical imaging capability over a broad temperature range. These results establish structural relaxation as a powerful strategy for engineering carrier transport in selenium-based semiconductors and position SeI2 as a promising solution-processable platform for infrared photodetection and thermal imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了硒碘（SeI2）从亚稳态玻璃相向有序层状结构转变过程中固态光电响应的演化规律，发现结构松弛可显著增强载流子传输，实现毫秒级红外探测（响应时间4.3 ms），探测率在1550 nm达到10⁸ Jones，可见光区达10¹¹ Jones，并展示了热成像能力。
AI.motivation: 非晶和部分结晶半导体的光电性能受结构无序性强烈影响，但建立结构演化与载流子传输之间的直接关联极具挑战性，亟需新的策略来理解和调控这类材料。
AI.method: 采用垂直分辨输运测量分析SeI₂薄膜深度依赖的电导率；通过观察结构松弛过程中光电性能的变化，结合空间光电流映射和热成像实验进行表征。
AI.result: (1) SeI₂薄膜呈现深度依赖的电导率，源于凝固过程的成分和结构不均匀性；(2) 玻璃态初期显示出缓慢载流子传输和持续光电导；(3) 结构松弛后实现显著传输增强，红外响应4.3 ms，8 kHz调制频率稳定工作，1550 nm探测率10⁸ Jones，可见光区10¹¹ Jones；(4) 空间光电流映射显示均匀的载流子收集；(5) 红外热成像验证了宽温度范围内的成像能力。
AI.conclusion: 结构松弛是工程化硒基半导体载流子传输的有效策略，SeI₂成为一种有前景的可溶液处理红外探测与热成像平台。

title: Magnons reveal topology and dynamics of a skyrmion crystal
summary: Although individual skyrmions are topologically protected objects, their cooperative crystalline order is fragile, easily disrupted by thermal fluctuations or other external perturbations. Probing the internal dynamics of such a crystal is both compelling and challenging, as its intricate and delicate spin texture must remain stable during measurement. Here, we engineer a nanoscale graphene junction hosting a skyrmion Wigner crystal, embedded between magnon emitters and detectors. The skyrmion crystal geometry leaves a striking imprint on magnon transport: as the gate voltage is varied, near-periodic windows of sharp fluctuations in magnon count are detected across the entire sample. We develop an interpretation that this results from skyrmions being added one by one to a quasi-one-dimensional array. Each burst of the fluctuations thus corresponds to the entry of an additional skyrmion, during which the lattice stiffness reduces. The impinging magnons induce and act as a probe of non-equilibrium collective dynamics of the crystal. These results establish a real-space probe of topological spin textures in quantum Hall-type insulating ground states via magnon transport and open opportunities to explore correlated, topologically ordered phases in moire and multilayer graphene systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在纳米石墨烯结中构建斯格明子维格纳晶体，利用磁子输运探测其集体动力学行为，发现随栅压变化出现近周期性磁子数涨落窗口，揭示斯格明子逐个加入一维阵列的过程。
AI.motivation: 斯格明子的拓扑保护特性使其晶体有序性易受热涨落等干扰，探测其内部动力学既重要又具挑战性，需要在不破坏自旋纹理的前提下进行测量。
AI.method: 设计纳米石墨烯结，在其中嵌入斯格明子维格纳晶体，两端连接磁子发射器和探测器，通过测量栅压变化下的磁子输运信号来探测晶体动力学。
AI.result: 观察到随栅压改变出现近周期性的磁子数剧烈涨落窗口，每个涨落对应一个斯格明子加入准一维阵列，此时晶格刚度降低。
AI.conclusion: 建立了通过磁子输运实时探测量子霍尔绝缘基态中拓扑自旋纹理的方法，为探索moiré和多层石墨烯系统中的拓扑有序相开辟了新途径。

title: Emergent Interfacial Magnetism in Epitaxial RuO$_2$
summary: The magnetic ground state of the altermagnet candidate RuO$_2$ remains controversial, with magnetic signatures observed mainly in epitaxial films. Here we show, using first-principles calculations, that magnetism in epitaxial RuO$_2$ can emerge as an interfacial boundary phase at TiO$_2$/RuO$_2$ interfaces. While TiO$_2$-induced epitaxial strain alone does not make (001)-oriented RuO$_2$ magnetic, explicit TiO$_2$/RuO$_2$ interfaces stabilize sizable Ru moments confined to the first few Ru layers. Charge-density and orbital-resolved analyses reveal interfacial electronic reconstruction, and substrate doping provides a route to tune the induced moments. In symmetric TiO$_2$/RuO$_2$/TiO$_2$ heterostructures, the two magnetic interfaces couple through the metallic RuO$_2$ spacer, producing a thickness-dependent alternation between weak-ferromagnetic and compensated altermagnetic states. Our results identify interface engineering as a practical route to stabilize and control fragile magnetism in RuO$_2$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算发现，外延RuO₂中的磁性并非体相本征性质，而是在TiO₂/RuO₂界面处作为界面边界相出现，且可通过界面工程稳定和调控。
AI.motivation: RuO₂的交变磁体候选材料的磁性基态存在争议，实验中磁性信号主要在外延薄膜中观测到，但其起源尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，分析TiO₂/RuO₂界面处的电子结构和磁性；结合电荷密度、轨道分辨分析以及衬底掺杂调控；构建对称TiO₂/RuO₂/TiO₂异质结构研究界面间磁耦合。
AI.result: TiO₂诱导的应变本身不足以使RuO₂产生磁性，但明确TiO₂/RuO₂界面可稳定尺寸可观的Ru磁矩，局限于前几层Ru层；衬底掺杂可调控诱导磁矩；对称异质结构中界面通过金属RuO₂间隔层耦合，产生厚度依赖的弱铁磁与补偿交变磁态交替。
AI.conclusion: 界面工程是稳定和调控RuO₂中脆弱磁性的实用途径。

title: Excitonic structure in CsPbBr$_3$ nanocubes, nanorods and nanoplatelets: the effect of dimensionality
summary: We present a theoretical study comparing the excitonic ground state properties of CsPbBr$_3$ nanocrystals with different dimensionality: nanorods (1D), nanoplatelets (2D) and nanocubes (3D). All three systems are described on equal footing, by means of a general variational effective mass model, which captures the influence of quantum confinement, dielectric confinement, electron-hole correlations and polaronic effects (within a Haken model). The strongly confined directions squeeze the exciton (X) wavefunction and enhance Coulomb attractions along the weakly confined directions. This stimulates superradiance, thus making radiative recombination rates speed up from cubes to platelets and to rods, in line with recent experiments. The anisotropic local field factor is a secondary, yet non-negligible, mechanism further enhancing radiative rates. X binding energies are also determined primarily by the directions of strong confinenement, which is also consistent with experiments. Weakly confined directions become however influential for small aspect ratios. Dielectric confinement plays a major role in determining the binding energies, and less so in the interparticle-distances. For all dimensionalities, the biexciton (XX) geometry is that of a distorted tetrahedron, rather than squared or linear distributions that would result in Coulomb-governed 2D and 1D structures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过统一的变分有效质量模型，理论比较了不同维度（纳米棒、纳米片、纳米立方体）CsPbBr₃纳米晶的激子基态性质，发现量子限制和介电限制共同决定了激子结合能、超辐射加速和辐射复合速率，并揭示了双激子构型为扭曲四面体而非低维库仑主导的分布。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在系统比较不同维度（1D、2D、3D）CsPbBr₃纳米晶的激子基态性质，解释实验观测到的辐射速率差异，并澄清量子限制、介电限制、电子-空穴关联及极化子效应在不同维度下的相对贡献。
AI.method: 采用统一的变分有效质量模型，同时考虑量子限制、介电限制、电子-空穴关联和Haken模型的极化子效应，对三种不同维度纳米晶进行等基础描述和比较。
AI.result: 强限制方向压缩激子波函数并增强弱限制方向的库仑吸引，从而加速超辐射，使辐射复合速率从立方体到纳米片到纳米棒依次增大；各向异性局域场因子进一步促进辐射速率。激子结合能主要由强限制方向决定，但弱限制方向在小纵横比时也有影响。介电限制对结合能影响显著，但对粒子间距离影响较小。所有维度下双激子构型均为扭曲四面体。
AI.conclusion: 维度对CsPbBr₃纳米晶的激子性质有决定性影响，强限制方向是控制激子行为的关键因素，超辐射加速效应按立方体→纳米片→纳米棒递增，与实验一致。介电限制主要影响结合能，双激子构型偏离低维库仑预期。

title: Subgrain-resolved Analysis of Degradation in Cu Metallization via Scanning 3DXRD and Thermomechanical Modeling
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, submitted to Microelectronic Engineering (ESREF 2026 Special Issue)
summary: Metallization layers play a key role in the performance and reliability of modern power semiconductor devices. During short-circuit events, rapid heating of power metallization layers induces thermomechanical incompatibility stresses, which may contribute to material degradation and impact device performance. In this work, potential degradation hotspots associated with thermomechanical loading in Cu power metallization are investigated using a combined experimental--computational approach. Scanning three-dimensional X-ray diffraction measurements are coupled with thermomechanical crystal plasticity simulations to probe the evolution of grain-resolved plastic deformation during rapid cyclic loading. This integrated approach provides insight into the microstructural processes governing degradation hotspot formation, laying the groundwork for future microstructure-informed, physics-based reliability assessment of Cu metallization.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验-计算结合的方法，利用三维X射线衍射和热机械晶体塑性模拟，研究了铜功率金属化层在短路事件中因热机械应力导致的微观结构退化热点形成机制。
AI.motivation: 功率半导体器件的金属化层在短路事件中会经历快速加热，引起热机械不匹配应力，导致材料退化并影响器件性能，因此需要探究其退化热点的形成机制。
AI.method: 采用扫描三维X射线衍射测量与热机械晶体塑性模拟相结合的方法，探测快速循环加载过程中晶粒分辨的塑性变形演化。
AI.result: 揭示了控制退化热点形成的微观结构过程，为未来基于微观结构的物理可靠性评估奠定基础。
AI.conclusion: 该集成方法为铜金属化层的微观结构-informed、基于物理的可靠性评估提供了理论基础。

title: Atomistic mechanism of corrosion-induced grain boundary migration in NiCr alloys in molten FLiNaK
summary: Corrosion of Ni-Cr structural alloys in molten fluoride salts is a persistent material degradation problem, yet the atomistic role of grain boundaries in this process remains poorly understood. Here we use reactive molecular dynamics to investigate corrosion of NiCr alloys in molten FLiNaK across four representative grain boundaries ($\Sigma3(111)$, $\Sigma11(113)$, $\Sigma5(012)$, and $\Sigma5(013)$) and corresponding bulk surfaces. Surface crystallography controls the initial dissolution stage, while grain boundary character governs the spatial localization and longer-time evolution of corrosion. We further identify a corrosion-driven grain boundary migration mechanism in which fluorine localization, preferential chromium dissolution, and vacancy-mediated mobility together drive interfacial motion away from the dealloyed region. The coherent $\Sigma3(111)$ boundary suppresses these processes, indicating low-energy special boundaries as targets for grain boundary engineering of corrosion-resistant Ni-Cr alloys.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过反应分子动力学模拟，揭示了NiCr合金在熔融FLiNaK盐中腐蚀时，晶界特性对腐蚀过程的关键影响，并发现腐蚀驱动晶界迁移机制，其中Σ3(111)共格晶界能有效抑制腐蚀，为耐腐蚀合金的晶界工程提供了设计目标。
AI.motivation: Ni-Cr结构合金在熔融氟盐中持续遭受腐蚀，但晶界在原子尺度上的作用机制尚不明确，缺乏对晶界类型如何影响腐蚀行为的系统理解。
AI.method: 采用反应分子动力学模拟，研究NiCr合金在熔融FLiNaK盐中四种代表性晶界（Σ3(111)、Σ11(113)、Σ5(012)、Σ5(013)）及对应体表面对腐蚀行为的影响。
AI.result: 表面晶体学控制初始溶解阶段，而晶界特征决定腐蚀的空间局域化和长期演化；发现腐蚀驱动的晶界迁移机制，涉及氟局域化、铬优先溶解和空位介导的迁移；Σ3(111)共格晶界能有效抑制这些过程。
AI.conclusion: 低能特殊晶界（如Σ3(111)）是耐腐蚀Ni-Cr合金晶界工程的重要设计目标，可显著提升合金在熔融氟盐环境中的抗腐蚀性能。

title: A Dynamical Phase-Field Model for the Optical Properties of Ferroelectrics
summary: Ferroelectric materials are promising platforms for controllable photonic devices because of the strong coupling between their spontaneous polarization and optical properties. Yet, these materials remain challenging to design because of the close connection between the ferroelectric domain structure and optical response, which no existing theoretical approach can capture. Here, we develop a dynamical phase-field model that directly couples the ferroelectric order to the local optical response by introducing an electronic polarization field. This approach enables the prediction of the spatially resolved temperature- and wavelength-dependent optical properties in complex ferroelectric microstructures. Applying this method to BaTiO3 thin films, we investigate the evolution of the local refractive index and electro-optic response under varying electric fields and temperatures. We show that the ferroelectric domain structure strongly modifies the local electro-optic response, exceeding 4000 pm/V near domain walls, several times larger than the bulk single crystal value (r_51=1300 pm/V). Our simulations quantitatively reproduce the electro-optic coefficient measured in BaTiO3 on silicon films and capture the temperature-dependent behavior across multiple ferroelectric phase transitions, revealing the role of phase competition and coexistence in determining the electro-optic response. More broadly, this work establishes a general approach for predicting light-matter interactions in complex ferroelectric microstructures, enabling the computational design of ferroelectric materials for photonics.
